circumstance: Coring a 1980s office slab for a new kitchen stack cuts a post-tension tendon the archived drawings placed in another band.
early_warning: A tendon scan or the original post-tension shop drawings would show the live profile under the proposed hole.
derisk: Scan the slab and recover the post-tension drawings before the penetration schedule is tendered.

circumstance: A reinforcement scan of a transfer slab shows the main bars in the top face, where the new riser opening assumed a conventional bottom-steel band.
project_types: refurbishment/fit-out; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: A cover meter survey would show which face of the slab is reinforced at the opening.
derisk: Scan representative bays and reconcile them with the opening design before tender.

circumstance: Removing a wall marked non-loadbearing in a 1960s walk-up drops the end bearing of the timber joists in the floor above.
early_warning: Joists visible in a ceiling strip-out would show the wall is carrying them.
derisk: Open the ceiling on both sides of every wall proposed for removal before demolition is tendered.

circumstance: The existing flat slab has a drop panel the measured survey recorded as a flush soffit, so the new main duct cannot pass.
trigger: coordinating a duct under an existing soffit
early_warning: A soffit survey at each column, not only at mid-bay, would show the drop panel.
derisk: Survey the soffit tightly enough to catch capitals and drop panels before services are tendered.

circumstance: Carbon-fibre strengthening is specified onto a soffit that still carries a cementitious coating the adhesive will not bond to.
trigger: bonding strengthening to an existing soffit
project_types: remediation/repair; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: A coating adhesion test would show the existing finish will not take the adhesive.
derisk: Identify the existing coating and the supplier's surface preparation before tender.

circumstance: Once rust scale is removed, a 1970s roof purlin is thinner than the size used to design the new plant platform.
trigger: setting new plant on an existing roof
early_warning: Ultrasonic thickness readings would show the steel remaining under the rust.
derisk: Measure remaining thickness, not the original size, before the plant frame is designed.

circumstance: Jacking an existing transfer beam to insert plates closes the movement joint between the original wing and a later extension.
early_warning: The joint is on the architectural set and would be crossed by the jacking sequence.
derisk: Mark every movement joint the temporary works must leave free before tender.

circumstance: A new stair void in a prestressed hollow-core office floor cuts strands the plank needs to carry the adjacent bay.
trigger: cutting a stair void in an existing floor
early_warning: The plank manufacturer's mark, or a scan, would show the strand positions.
derisk: Confirm span direction and strand zones before the void is tendered.

circumstance: The pad footing under a column to be kept was sized for two storeys, and the vertical extension adds a third.
early_warning: Original footing drawings compared with the new column load would show the shortfall.
derisk: Calculate the existing footing against the added load before tender.

circumstance: Concrete cancer on a coastal balcony edge has reduced the reinforcement so the balustrade post can no longer be refixed into it.
early_warning: A cover survey and chloride test would show the loss of steel in the edge.
derisk: Test the edge reinforcement before the balustrade replacement is tendered.

circumstance: A band beam hidden above a suspended ceiling is cut for a new riser because the demolition drawing showed a flat plate.
trigger: cutting a riser through an existing slab
early_warning: A strip of ceiling removed at the riser line would expose the beam.
derisk: Open the ceiling on every proposed penetration line before demolition is tendered.

circumstance: Starter bars for a new school mezzanine are drilled into an existing beam whose scan shows too little edge distance.
trigger: fixing a new mezzanine to an existing beam
early_warning: A scan of the beam edge would show the bar positions relative to the proposed anchors.
derisk: Scan the beam edge and check anchor edge distance before the mezzanine is tendered.

circumstance: The timber lintel over a shopfront is carrying a storey of solid brick the alteration drawing treated as veneer.
early_warning: Brick thickness measured at the reveal would show a solid wall rather than a veneer.
derisk: Confirm wall thickness and lintel type before the opening is tendered.

circumstance: Ceiling linings come down to show that a previous renovation has already cut the rafter ties, and the roof is spreading.
trigger: replacing a ceiling under an existing roof
early_warning: A roof-space inspection would show the missing ties and the spread at the eaves.
derisk: Inspect the roof space before any ceiling or load is added.

circumstance: A new lift overrun cuts the roof truss bottom chord that is still tying the existing portal frame.
trigger: forming a lift overrun in an existing roof
early_warning: The truss drawing read against the overrun setout would show the chord in the opening.
derisk: Coordinate the overrun with the truss engineer before tender.

circumstance: Core drilling a rainwater downpipe through a post-tensioned podium hits a live tendon near its anchorage.
early_warning: The anchorage zone is shown on post-tension drawings and is the worst place to core.
derisk: Keep new drains out of anchorage zones identified on the shop drawings.

circumstance: Existing slab deflection has already cracked the blockwork the fit-out intended to keep as an intertenancy wall.
trigger: retaining an existing wall as a separation
early_warning: A crack survey would show movement the new rating cannot rely on.
derisk: Survey cracks and decide which walls can be retained before tender.

circumstance: A column to be strengthened with plates is out of plumb by more than the plate detail can pack.
early_warning: A plumb survey of the column would show the gap the plates cannot close.
derisk: Survey the column line before the strengthening plates are fabricated.

circumstance: Precast flooring units span the opposite way to the 1990s drawings, so the proposed penetration cuts the span.
trigger: cutting a penetration in an existing floor
early_warning: The unit edges visible at a ceiling opening would show the real span direction.
derisk: Confirm span direction on site before penetrations are tendered.

circumstance: An existing car-park slab designed for cars is asked to carry a compactus room in the new fit-out.
trigger: placing compactus storage on an existing slab
early_warning: The original live-load note compared with the compactus load would show the overload.
derisk: Check the existing slab load against the storage load before tender.

circumstance: Crack monitoring shows an existing transfer wall is still moving, so a new storey cannot land on it.
trigger: adding load above an existing transfer
early_warning: Tell-tales or a monitoring report would show the crack is live.
derisk: Monitor the crack before the added storey is tendered.

circumstance: Hold-down bolts for a new rooftop plant frame clash with post-tension anchorages already cast in the roof slab.
trigger: fixing a plant frame to an existing roof
early_warning: Post-tension drawings would show anchorages inside the proposed bolt group.
derisk: Set the frame out clear of anchorages before fabrication.

circumstance: A masonry pier that looked bonded to the party wall is only toothed, and it cannot be treated as a support.
early_warning: A small opening at the junction would show the pier is not bonded.
derisk: Prove the connection before the pier is used as a support.

circumstance: Cavity ties in a 1970s veneer have corroded, so the outer leaf the reclad design kept is no longer tied to the inner leaf.
early_warning: A borescope of the cavity would show failed ties.
derisk: Inspect ties before a retention scheme is tendered.

circumstance: A new opening in a shear wall leaves a pier narrower than the temporary-works design allowed during construction.
trigger: cutting a door in a shear wall
early_warning: The temporary-works sketch would show the pier left is too slender.
derisk: Agree the temporary pier size with the structural engineer before demolition.

circumstance: The existing ground slab has no vapour barrier, and the new vinyl specification needs a dryness the moisture test does not achieve.
trigger: laying vinyl on an existing slab
early_warning: A moisture test would show the slab is too wet for the adhesive.
derisk: Moisture-test the slab before the floor finish is specified.

circumstance: Settlement between an old wing and a 1990s extension has closed the movement joint the new floor finish was going to bridge.
trigger: bridging a joint with a new finish
early_warning: A level survey across the joint would show it has already closed.
derisk: Survey the joint and detail the finish to suit the movement that is left.

circumstance: An existing steel beam nominated for a new hoist is a different depth from the fabrication drawing in the building manual.
trigger: hanging a hoist from an existing beam
early_warning: A tape of the beam depth would show it is not the section on the drawing.
derisk: Measure the beam before the hoist connection is designed.

circumstance: Drilling chemical anchors finds a void in a waffle-slab rib the survey treated as solid concrete.
early_warning: The waffle layout on the original drawing would show ribs and voids.
derisk: Read the waffle drawing before anchor positions are set.

circumstance: Welding a new cleat is blocked by intumescent paint that cannot be reinstated to the same rating on the reduced section.
early_warning: The fire-protection specification would show the member is coated and the coat is part of the rating.
derisk: Detail connections that do not destroy a coating that cannot be matched.

circumstance: A new awning is fixed to a spandrel beam the original design treated as non-structural trim.
trigger: fixing an awning to an existing facade
early_warning: The original structural set would show the spandrel is not a loadbearing member.
derisk: Confirm the member's role before the awning load is attached.

circumstance: A chase cut in a precast wall panel for a new service finds prestressing strand closer to the face than the cover assumed.
early_warning: The panel shop drawing would show strand positions and cover.
derisk: Obtain the panel drawings before any chase is specified.

circumstance: The existing floor steps at a construction joint by more than a topping can correct without exceeding the slab's spare capacity.
early_warning: A level survey would show the step and the topping weight it implies.
derisk: Survey levels and check topping load before the finish is tendered.

circumstance: A retained party wall has no footing of its own once the neighbour's slab on this side is cut back for the extension.
trigger: cutting back a slab beside a party wall
early_warning: A trial pit at the wall would show whether a footing exists.
derisk: Dig a trial pit before the slab is cut.

circumstance: The existing basement wall moves when dewatering for the adjoining extension is switched on.
early_warning: A dilapidation survey and piezometers would show the wall is sensitive to groundwater.
derisk: Monitor the wall and agree drawdown limits before dewatering starts.

circumstance: The existing steel connection uses rivets, and the new strengthening detail assumed bolts could reuse the same holes.
early_warning: A close inspection would show rivets rather than bolts.
derisk: Confirm the fastener type before the strengthening is detailed.

circumstance: A new condenser zone sits on the roof sheet span rather than on the purlins, and the sheeting cannot carry the point load.
trigger: placing condensers on an existing roof
early_warning: The purlin setout against the plant feet would show the feet miss the purlins.
derisk: Land plant feet on purlins or add framing before tender.

circumstance: Joists in a school building have been notched for old heating pipes until the remaining section no longer works.
early_warning: Lifting floorboards would show the notches.
derisk: Inspect joists before the floor is relied on for a new use.

circumstance: An infill slab from a past renovation has no visible connection to the surrounding beams, so it cannot act as a diaphragm.
trigger: relying on an old infill as diaphragm
early_warning: Breaking out a small edge would show whether the infill is connected.
derisk: Prove the connection before the slab is used for lateral load.

circumstance: Balustrade posts cast into the slab edge cannot be removed without breaking reinforcement the waterproofing repair needs to keep.
early_warning: The post embedment is obvious once tiles are lifted at one post.
derisk: Agree which posts stay before the membrane repair is tendered.

circumstance: A proposed rigging point in a civic hall lands on a prestressed beam that cannot be drilled.
early_warning: The structural drawings would show prestress in that beam.
derisk: Keep fixings out of prestressed members identified on the drawings.

circumstance: The existing crane runway is out of level beyond the tolerance of the replacement crane.
early_warning: A runway survey would show gauge and level outside the crane tolerance.
derisk: Survey the runway before the crane is ordered.

circumstance: Cover to a car-park soffit is too low for the carbonation-repair coating to build to the specified thickness on the high spots.
early_warning: A cover survey would show the high spots the coating cannot fill.
derisk: Survey cover and agree a repair system that suits it before tender.

circumstance: A services hanger is fixed into the thin flange of a precast tee whose load chart does not allow that fixing.
trigger: hanging services from a precast tee
early_warning: The manufacturer's chart, once found, limits fixings in the flange.
derisk: Obtain the tee data before hanger positions are set.

circumstance: A new intertenancy wall detail crosses a slab movement joint as if the slab were continuous.
trigger: building a wall across a joint
early_warning: The joint is on the structural set and is crossed by the wall type.
derisk: Break the wall at every structural joint before the detail is issued.

circumstance: Scanning shows a service tunnel cast in the slab on the line of a new blade wall.
trigger: standing a wall on an existing slab
early_warning: A scan or the original services drawing would show the tunnel.
derisk: Scan the wall line before the wall is documented.

circumstance: A past overlay of concrete tiles is already using the reserve a solar array was going to take on a roof designed for sheet.
early_warning: The original roof design load compared with the tiles-plus-array load would show the overload.
derisk: Weigh the existing roof build-up before the array is specified.

circumstance: An existing cantilevered concrete hood has sagged, and the new glazed screen cannot be set square to it.
trigger: fixing a screen to an existing hood
early_warning: A straight-edge survey would show the sag.
derisk: Survey the hood before the screen is fabricated.

circumstance: Grit-blasting an existing portal knee for recoating shows a lack of fusion the strengthening design had treated as a sound weld.
early_warning: The defect is hidden until the coating is removed.
derisk: Allow for weld inspection after blasting, before strengthening is fabricated.

circumstance: A new opening beside an existing lift shaft leaves a nib too narrow for the reinforcement the fire-rated wall needs.
trigger: forming an opening beside a lift shaft
early_warning: The nib dimension on the drawing is less than the rated-wall build-up.
derisk: Check the nib against the wall system before tender.

circumstance: Existing ground beams sit higher than the new in-ground drains, so the drains cannot pass without a penetration the beams were not designed for.
trigger: laying new drains through an existing ground floor
early_warning: A footing survey against the drain long section would show the clash.
derisk: Survey footing depths before the drainage design is frozen.

circumstance: Core logs from a previous tenant fit-out show the slab is already holed on the only path left for the new hydraulic riser.
early_warning: The previous penetration drawings, if recovered, would show the holes.
derisk: Collect old fit-out drawings and scan the riser path before tender.

circumstance: The brick parapet is poorly tied to the roof slab, which shows only when the coping is removed for recladding.
early_warning: A trial opening at the coping would show the tie, or the lack of one.
derisk: Open a sample of parapet before the reclad is tendered.

circumstance: A retained timber post in a warehouse has its bearing end buried in a damp masonry pocket and is decayed.
early_warning: Probing the pocket would show decay.
derisk: Expose post ends before they are relied on.

circumstance: Laboratory equipment loads land between the ribs of an existing ribbed slab.
trigger: placing equipment on an existing floor
early_warning: The rib spacing against the equipment feet would show the feet miss the ribs.
derisk: Align equipment with ribs or design a spreader before tender.

circumstance: An existing folding-partition track is fixed to a beam that deflects more than the track can tolerate, and the brief assumed the track could be reused.
early_warning: A deflection check of the beam under the new loads would show the track will rack.
derisk: Check beam deflection against the track tolerance before reuse is promised.

circumstance: The existing stair flight is built into a brick wall that the strip-out schedule demolishes.
trigger: demolishing a wall beside a retained stair
early_warning: The stair-to-wall junction, once the lining is off, shows the stair depends on the wall.
derisk: Confirm how the stair is supported before the wall is scheduled for removal.

circumstance: Chemical anchors for seismic restraint of new plant do not have the edge distance the existing slab edge can give.
trigger: restraining plant on an existing slab
early_warning: The anchor data sheet against the slab-edge setout would show the shortfall.
derisk: Check edge distance before the restraint is specified.

circumstance: Chasing a new floor waste finds a heating coil buried in the existing topping.
early_warning: A thermal scan or the old heating drawing would show the coil.
derisk: Locate heating coils before floor wastes are set out.

circumstance: A past strengthening plate occupies the face the new services bracket was detailed to weld to.
trigger: welding a bracket to an existing beam
early_warning: A site photo of the beam face would show the plate.
derisk: Inspect the beam face before the bracket is detailed.

circumstance: The building's lateral system depends on a masonry wall the fit-out now wants to penetrate for a hose-reel cupboard.
trigger: cutting a cupboard into a bracing wall
early_warning: The bracing drawing would show the wall is structural.
derisk: Keep cupboards out of bracing walls identified on the structural set.

circumstance: Floor levels in two buildings being linked differ by more than a ramp can resolve inside the link the planning envelope allows.
early_warning: A level survey of both floors would show the difference.
derisk: Survey both buildings to the same datum before the link is designed.

circumstance: The seat of a precast facade panel has spalled, so the panel the reclad intended to retain no longer has its design bearing.
early_warning: A close survey of the seat would show the spall.
derisk: Inspect seats before panels are nominated for retention.

circumstance: A new dormer cuts a hip rafter the remaining roof geometry still needs.
trigger: cutting a dormer into an existing roof
early_warning: The roof framing plan would show the hip in the dormer opening.
derisk: Frame the dormer around the hip, or replace the hip, before tender.

circumstance: The balcony membrane turns up short of the door sill once the new tiles and bed are allowed for.
early_warning: Lifting one tile at the door would show the upturn height against the sill.
derisk: Expose the upturn at sills and posts before the repair scope is tendered.

circumstance: A combustible cladding panel is identified on a mid-rise facade the reclad brief had described as solid aluminium.
early_warning: A core sample of the panel would show a combustible core.
derisk: Sample the cladding before the reclad specification is written.

circumstance: The existing curtain wall stack joint has closed because the slab has deflected more than the joint was sized for.
early_warning: A joint-width survey floor by floor would show joints already closed.
derisk: Measure stack joints before any glass or seal replacement is tendered.

circumstance: Window openings in a 1970s school are outside the adjustment range of the replacement frames.
early_warning: A survey of opening sizes would show the variation.
derisk: Survey every opening before frames are ordered.

circumstance: The existing brick ties are too short for the cavity the new rainscreen needs, and the veneer cannot be kept.
trigger: installing a rainscreen over existing veneer
early_warning: A cavity measurement would show the depth available.
derisk: Measure the cavity before the rainscreen build-up is specified.

circumstance: Sealant specified for the stone facade is incompatible with the existing impregnator, and the trial bead will not bond.
early_warning: A bond test on the actual stone would fail.
derisk: Bond-test the sealant on the existing stone before it is specified.

circumstance: The slab edge is not on the facade grid, so the replacement curtain-wall brackets miss the designed anchor line.
early_warning: A facade survey against the slab edge would show the offset.
derisk: Survey the slab edge before brackets are fabricated.

circumstance: Weep holes in the existing veneer were rendered over during a previous paint cycle, and the cavity cannot drain.
early_warning: A visual check at the base course would show the weeps are closed.
derisk: Confirm weeps are open before the facade is recoated.

circumstance: A new balcony door threshold ends up below the external tiling once the falls are rebuilt to the waste.
early_warning: A section through the tile build-up would show the threshold is too low.
derisk: Set the threshold from the finished tile falls, not the slab.

circumstance: Balustrade base plates are bolted through the new membrane because the sleeve was left off the detail.
early_warning: The detail would show a bolt through the membrane with no sleeve.
derisk: Detail a post sleeve or a side-fixed plate before tender.

circumstance: The glass channel of a new balustrade holds water against the slab edge the membrane is trying to protect.
trigger: installing a glass channel on a balcony edge
early_warning: The channel section has no drain, which a review of the shop drawing would show.
derisk: Require the channel to drain before it is approved.

circumstance: Parapet capping falls back toward the roof, and the membrane termination cannot accept that water.
early_warning: A level on the capping would show the fall is inward where the detail wanted it outward.
derisk: Check capping falls before the membrane is terminated.

circumstance: The existing wall is out of plumb beyond the adjustment of the new rainscreen brackets.
early_warning: A plumb survey would show the wall is outside the bracket range.
derisk: Survey plumb before the bracket system is chosen.

circumstance: Head flashings on replacement windows stop short of the jambs, so water tracks into the reveal.
early_warning: The flashing cut length against the opening width would show it is short.
derisk: Inspect flashings before linings close the reveal.

circumstance: The sub-sill tray is flat and holds water under the replacement window.
early_warning: A level on the tray would show no fall to the outside.
derisk: Require a fall on the tray in the window detail.

circumstance: A fire cavity barrier closes the drainage path the new cladding system needs.
early_warning: The barrier detail blocks the cavity with no drained path.
derisk: Detail the barrier so the cavity can still drain.

circumstance: Coastal exposure is harsher than the powder-coat warranty on the replacement louvres will accept.
trigger: specifying louvres on a coastal site
early_warning: The site's distance to salt water against the warranty would show the exclusion.
derisk: Match the coating to the actual exposure before the louvres are specified.

circumstance: Existing sarking under tiles being kept is torn at the eaves, and the new gutter relies on it to discharge.
early_warning: Lifting tiles at the eaves would show the torn sarking.
derisk: Inspect sarking before the gutter scope is frozen.

circumstance: Batten gauge on the existing roof does not suit the replacement tile the supplier has delivered.
early_warning: The tile manufacturer's gauge against the existing batten spacing would not match.
derisk: Confirm the tile gauge before battens are reused.

circumstance: A dormer cheek meets the existing tiles with no soaker, and the junction is only butted.
trigger: tying a dormer into an existing tiled roof
early_warning: The junction detail, if drawn, would require a soaker that is missing on site.
derisk: Detail the roof-to-wall flashing before the dormer is tendered.

circumstance: Aluminium flashing in contact with the existing copper valley is corroding at the junction.
trigger: joining new flashing to existing metal
early_warning: A materials schedule would show the two metals touching.
derisk: Separate dissimilar metals in the flashing detail.

circumstance: The long roof sheet's expansion exceeds the clip movement on a north-facing industrial roof.
early_warning: The sheet length against the clip data would show the movement is too large.
derisk: Check thermal movement for the actual sheet length before the clip is chosen.

circumstance: Render over the existing lightweight sheet cracks along every sheet joint the specification did not reinforce.
early_warning: The sheet joints are visible before render and need a joint treatment.
derisk: Specify joint reinforcement before render is tendered.

circumstance: The new facade coating delaminates because it was applied over a chalking existing coating.
early_warning: A chalk test or adhesion trial would fail on the existing film.
derisk: Adhesion-test the new coating on the existing surface before specification.

circumstance: The sealant joint on the existing precast is too narrow for the movement the joint has to take.
early_warning: Measuring the joint width against the sealant's movement class would show it is too narrow.
derisk: Measure joints and select a sealant that fits them.

circumstance: Spandrel insulation stops short of the slab, so the fire and thermal line breaks at the existing slab edge.
early_warning: The slab-edge dimension against the insulation thickness would show the gap.
derisk: Detail the insulation to meet the slab before installation.

circumstance: Curtain-wall weeps are blocked by fire-stopping installed hard against the transom.
early_warning: The fire-stop detail overlapping the weep would show the blockage.
derisk: Keep fire-stopping clear of the frame's drainage path.

circumstance: A new opening in the veneer has no lintel bearing because the existing pier was narrower than drawn.
early_warning: Measuring the pier would show the bearing is short.
derisk: Measure piers before lintels are ordered.

circumstance: A green-roof build-up on an existing podium exceeds both the slab load and the membrane's trafficable rating.
trigger: converting a podium to a green roof
early_warning: Saturated weight against the slab capacity and the membrane data would show both limits are exceeded.
derisk: Check saturated weight and the membrane system before the green roof is specified.

circumstance: The planter membrane finishes below the soil, so the upturn cannot be inspected or maintained.
trigger: building a planter on a podium
early_warning: The section shows the membrane ending in the soil.
derisk: Terminate the membrane above soil level.

circumstance: An acoustic requirement deepens the facade zone until it hits the existing slab edge.
early_warning: The acoustic build-up depth against the slab-edge dimension would clash.
derisk: Agree the facade zone with structure before the acoustic build-up is specified.

circumstance: Safety glass was not supplied to a low-level pane in a school corridor that requires it.
early_warning: The glass marking, or the lack of it, would show ordinary glass in a safety zone.
derisk: Specify the grade and check the marking before installation.

circumstance: An existing skylight well is unlined and drips condensation into a classroom once the roof space is cooled by new insulation.
trigger: insulating a roof around an existing skylight
early_warning: The unlined well is visible from the roof space.
derisk: Line and insulate the well as part of the roof upgrade.

circumstance: Double-glazed units in a 1990s hospital facade have failed seals and the cavities are fogged.
early_warning: A visual survey would show the fogged units.
derisk: Survey the facade and allow for unit replacement before tender.

circumstance: The window stay clashes with the new reveal lining in a heritage sash replacement.
early_warning: The stay's arc against the reveal depth would clash.
derisk: Coordinate hardware and reveal depth before linings are fixed.

circumstance: Leaf build-up blocks a box gutter that has no overflow, and water enters the ceiling of the top-floor ward.
early_warning: The gutter detail has no overflow, which a roof inspection would confirm.
derisk: Add an overflow that discharges outside before the next wet season.

circumstance: A box-gutter sump is not at the low point once the gutter deflects under a maintenance load.
early_warning: A water test would show the sump is not at the low point.
derisk: Water-test the gutter before linings below are closed.

circumstance: Upper roof run-off from an existing copper roof lands on a new aluminium awning and stains it.
trigger: adding an awning under an existing roof
early_warning: The roof material above the awning is copper, which the awning specification did not address.
derisk: Keep copper run-off off aluminium, or separate the surfaces.

circumstance: The existing single-skin masonry wall cannot provide the cavity the new cladding system requires.
early_warning: The wall thickness survey would show there is no cavity.
derisk: Choose a system that suits a solid wall before tender.

circumstance: Photovoltaic feet are a penetration pattern the existing membrane warranty will not accept.
trigger: mounting photovoltaic frames on an existing roof
early_warning: The membrane warranty lists acceptable penetration details, and the frame is not among them.
derisk: Agree the foot detail with the membrane manufacturer before the array is designed.

circumstance: A roof anchor layout cuts the laps of the new membrane.
trigger: installing safety anchors on a new membrane
early_warning: The anchor grid over the lap plan would show anchors on laps.
derisk: Set anchors off laps before either trade starts.

circumstance: An exhaust curb sits on the low side of an existing roof and dams the falls to the outlet.
trigger: cutting a new exhaust through an existing roof
early_warning: The roof falls drawing would show the curb on the low side.
derisk: Place curbs so they do not block falls.

circumstance: The existing box gutter is cast into the structure and cannot be deepened to take the added roof catchment.
trigger: adding roof area to an existing gutter
early_warning: The gutter section against the new catchment would show it is too small and cannot be deepened.
derisk: Resize the catchment or add an outlet before the extension is tendered.

circumstance: A sealed overflow from a box gutter now discharges into the ceiling because the external outlet was built over.
early_warning: The old overflow location is on the roof plan and is covered by the new work.
derisk: Trace overflows before new work covers them.

circumstance: Tile underlay stops short of the new gutter and wind-driven rain enters the eaves.
trigger: retiled roof to a new gutter
early_warning: The underlay should discharge into the gutter, which a lift of the bottom course would show it does not.
derisk: Inspect the underlay-to-gutter junction before scaffolding comes down.

circumstance: A ridge vent sits on the weather face rather than in the dry zone under the ridge tile.
early_warning: The vent position relative to the ridge cover would show it is exposed.
derisk: Place the vent in the dry zone under the ridge.

circumstance: Mixed polycarbonate and metal sheets on a warehouse roof expand differently and tear the shared fasteners.
trigger: replacing part of a roof with a different sheet
early_warning: The two products' movement data would not match a shared fixing.
derisk: Separate the sheets or use a fixing that allows both movements.

circumstance: Oil-canning on a low-pitch architectural roof is unacceptable at the purlin spacing already built.
early_warning: The sheet span tables against the existing purlin spacing would show the span is too wide for the flatness wanted.
derisk: Check span and gauge before the sheet is ordered.

circumstance: Davit bases for facade access clash with the pads of the replacement cooling towers.
early_warning: Both layouts claim the same roof zone.
derisk: Coordinate davits and plant before either is tendered.

circumstance: The fascia was reset before the new pavement levels, and the gutter can no longer reach its outlet above the drain.
trigger: resetting a fascia during an extension
early_warning: The gutter invert against the pavement level would show the outlet is trapped.
derisk: Set the gutter from the finished site levels.

circumstance: Existing metal roof fixings have lost their seals, and a like-for-like replacement screw is no longer sold for that sheet.
early_warning: The sheet profile does not match current screw washers.
derisk: Identify the sheet profile and a compatible fixing before the repair is tendered.

circumstance: A heritage render sample does not match the existing facade once it is viewed in the street light rather than the workshop.
early_warning: A sample panel on the building would show the mismatch the workshop sample hid.
derisk: Approve samples on the building before the repair proceeds.

circumstance: The floor-waste flange in an existing bathroom will not accept the lap of the replacement membrane.
early_warning: The flange type, once tiles are lifted, does not match the membrane's approved termination.
derisk: Expose the flange and match the membrane system to it before tender.

circumstance: A 1970s bathroom slab was cast without a set-down, so the new membrane has nowhere to form falls to the waste.
early_warning: Levels on the bare slab would show no set-down.
derisk: Survey the slab before the waterproofing system is chosen.

circumstance: The shower hob in a strata lot is lower than the upturn the replacement membrane needs.
early_warning: Measuring the hob against the upturn height would show it is short.
derisk: Raise the hob or change the termination before tiling.

circumstance: The shower screen channel is rebated through the new membrane because the screen was set out on the tiles.
early_warning: The rebate depth would cut the membrane, which the screen shop drawing shows.
derisk: Set the screen on a detail that does not cut the membrane.

circumstance: The tile bed is thicker than the set-down, so water at the bathroom door flows into the carpet of the adjacent bedroom.
early_warning: A section of the bed thickness against the set-down would show the finished floor is too high.
derisk: Set tile thickness so the bathroom remains below the adjacent floor.

circumstance: Moisture in the existing slab is too high for the membrane the fit-out specification named.
trigger: laying a membrane on an existing slab
early_warning: A moisture test would exceed the membrane's limit.
derisk: Test the slab and select a system that tolerates it before tender.

circumstance: The shower waste was set high during a previous renovation, so falls in the new bed run away from it.
early_warning: A level on the waste against the slab would show the waste is the high point.
derisk: Reset the waste before the bed is laid.

circumstance: A balcony door has no puddle flange, and the existing membrane stops on bare concrete under the sill.
early_warning: Lifting the threshold would show the membrane is not terminated in a flange.
derisk: Include a flange in the repair scope before tender.

circumstance: Backfill against a new basement tanking is placed before the protection board, and the membrane is torn.
early_warning: The membrane specification requires protection before backfill.
derisk: Hold backfill until protection is inspected.

circumstance: The waterstop in a basement construction joint is displaced during the pour and is no longer centred.
early_warning: The waterstop should be visible and centred before the second pour, which an inspection would check.
derisk: Inspect the waterstop immediately before the closing pour.

circumstance: A hydraulic pipe passes through the podium membrane with no sleeve, so the sheet is dressed to a pipe that moves.
early_warning: The penetration detail shows a bare pipe rather than a sleeve.
derisk: Sleeve every pipe before the membrane is applied.

circumstance: The internal floor of a ground-floor fit-out sits below the external paving, and there is no drain at the threshold.
trigger: fitting out a space below external paving
early_warning: A level survey would show the internal floor is the low point.
derisk: Raise the floor or add a drain before tender.

circumstance: Two membrane systems meet at a podium-to-planter junction and neither manufacturer will warrant the joint.
early_warning: Both data sheets exclude the other's product at the junction.
derisk: Use one system, or obtain a written junction detail from both, before tender.

circumstance: A flood test of a refurbished wet area fails at the pipe penetration behind the bath.
early_warning: The test holds everywhere except the penetration.
derisk: Leave penetrations exposed for the test.

circumstance: The wall membrane and the floor membrane in a new ensuite never lap because they were installed by different visits with no sequence.
early_warning: The lap is missing at the junction, which a pre-tile inspection would see.
derisk: Inspect the lap before tiling.

circumstance: A balcony grate sits proud of the new tiles and ponds water against the door.
trigger: tiling up to a balcony outlet
early_warning: The grate level against the tile would show it is high.
derisk: Set the grate to the finished tile.

circumstance: A podium planter has no drain, and the membrane sits in water it was not detailed as a tank to hold.
trigger: forming a planter on a slab
early_warning: The section shows soil on a membrane with no outlet.
derisk: Drain the planter and terminate the membrane as a tank if it must hold water.

circumstance: A new lining in a basement would hide a crack that is still leaking.
early_warning: Damp on the crack after rain would show it is live.
derisk: Stop the leak before any lining is specified.

circumstance: The drainage cell behind a basement wall has no outlet, so hydrostatic pressure remains on the tanking.
early_warning: The cell detail has no pipe to a pump or a daylight point.
derisk: Give the cell an outlet before the wall is documented.

circumstance: Lift-pit buffers and the sump are cast through the tanking with no collar.
early_warning: The pit inserts are not on the waterproofing detail.
derisk: Collar every pit insert into the tanking.

circumstance: A boundary retaining wall cannot be tanked on the soil face because the neighbour will not give access.
early_warning: The wall is on the boundary and the detail needs the far face.
derisk: Design a negative-side system if the soil face cannot be reached.

circumstance: A negative-side product specified for an existing basement cannot resist the head of water found once the wall is opened.
trigger: treating a leaking basement from inside
early_warning: Piezometers or a water-level reading would show a higher head than the product allows.
derisk: Measure the head before the product is chosen.

circumstance: The podium expansion-joint seal is too small for the movement the joint was designed to take.
early_warning: The joint width and the calculated movement exceed the seal's class.
derisk: Size the seal to the movement, not to the available gap after finishes.

circumstance: Tiles go down on a podium before the membrane is flood-tested.
early_warning: The programme shows finishes before the test.
derisk: Test the membrane while it is still exposed.

circumstance: The following trade punctures an unprotected membrane while fixing a door frame.
early_warning: There is no protection board on the programme between membrane and frames.
derisk: Protect the membrane before other trades return.

circumstance: Membrane laps on a repaired roof face up the fall.
early_warning: The lap direction against the falls would show water can run into the joint.
derisk: Lap sheets down the fall.

circumstance: The clamping ring supplied with the new membrane does not fit the outlet bowl cast into the existing roof.
trigger: terminating a membrane at an existing outlet
early_warning: The outlet brand, once exposed, is not the ring in the specification.
derisk: Identify the outlet before the membrane system is ordered.

circumstance: A new membrane is incompatible with the existing copper outlet it has to terminate on.
trigger: tying a new membrane to an old outlet
early_warning: The membrane data sheet excludes copper, which the outlet is.
derisk: Confirm outlet metal against the membrane before specification.

circumstance: Niche fixings in a refurbished shower penetrate the membrane because the niche was lined after the sheet.
early_warning: Screw points are through the only water barrier.
derisk: Fix the niche into backing that is not the membrane, or seal each fixing as a penetration.

circumstance: The bath lip sits below the line the wall membrane must reach.
trigger: replacing a bath in an existing bathroom
early_warning: The lip height against the upturn would show a gap.
derisk: Choose a bath whose lip can take the membrane.

circumstance: An acrylic shower base rocks on an uneven existing slab and opens the junction to the wall membrane.
trigger: setting a shower base on an existing slab
early_warning: A straight edge on the slab would show the hollow under the base.
derisk: Bed the base fully before the wall junction is sealed.

circumstance: A like-for-like bathroom refit has no set-down left, so falls to the waste cannot be formed in the remaining thickness.
early_warning: Finished-floor levels would show no room for falls.
derisk: Confirm thickness available before promising a tiled fall.

circumstance: The door jamb installation cuts the membrane upturn at the bathroom entry.
early_warning: The jamb fixing lands in the upturn.
derisk: Install the jamb over a protected upturn.

circumstance: A balcony overflow discharges onto the facade below, which has no flashing to take it.
early_warning: The overflow point is above an unflashed wall.
derisk: Flash the discharge clear of the wall.

circumstance: A window in a shower wall is outside the membrane system and leaks at the frame.
early_warning: The frame is in the wet zone and is not part of the membrane detail.
derisk: Include the frame in the waterproofing scope.

circumstance: The substrate board in a wet-area refit is not a wet-area board and swells behind the membrane.
early_warning: The board stamp is not a wet-area grade.
derisk: Specify and check the board grade before the membrane.

circumstance: A later fixing for under-tile heating cuts both the cable and the membrane.
trigger: fixing a floor waste after heating is laid
early_warning: The heating layout crosses the waste.
derisk: Set out wastes before the heating cable is fixed.

circumstance: A pile head penetrates the blinding membrane of a new basement with no collar.
early_warning: The pile is not on the waterproofing detail.
derisk: Collar every pile before the membrane continues.

circumstance: The kicker joint at the base of a basement wall leaks after the first wet week.
early_warning: The joint has no waterstop, which the pour record would show was omitted.
derisk: Include and inspect a waterstop at the kicker.

circumstance: A slab on ground for a new house is poured with a vapour barrier that stops short of the edge beam.
early_warning: The barrier does not reach the edge, which a pre-pour inspection would see.
derisk: Inspect continuity of the barrier before the pour.

circumstance: Bar chairs puncture the vapour barrier and the holes are left untaped.
trigger: placing reinforcement on a vapour barrier
early_warning: Punctures are visible before the pour.
derisk: Tape punctures before concrete is placed.

circumstance: Irrigation is drilled through a podium membrane after the flood test has been signed off.
early_warning: The irrigation layout was not in the penetration schedule that was tested.
derisk: Include every later pipe in the test.

circumstance: Terrace tiles are bonded to the membrane, so they cannot be lifted without destroying the water barrier.
early_warning: A trial lift takes the membrane with the tile.
derisk: Allow for a full membrane replacement if tiles are bonded.

circumstance: A split-level slab step is too sharp for the membrane to turn without a fillet that does not fit.
early_warning: The step radius is tighter than the membrane's minimum fillet.
derisk: Form a fillet the sheet can turn.

circumstance: A plant-room floor cannot be flood-tested because the perimeter is too low to hold water.
early_warning: The hob height is less than the test water depth.
derisk: Provide a perimeter that can hold the test.

circumstance: An aged-care ensuite shares a membrane with a corridor that has no set-down, and water tracks into the corridor.
trigger: waterproofing an ensuite opening to a corridor
early_warning: The threshold is flush and the corridor is not protected.
derisk: Detail a hob or a drain the access requirements can accept.

circumstance: A commercial kitchen floor waste is not accessible once the new cool room is placed over it.
trigger: setting a cool room on an existing kitchen floor
early_warning: The cool-room outline covers the waste.
derisk: Move the waste or the room before either is fixed.

circumstance: The existing copper shower tray has pinholes, and the new screen is detailed to seal to a tray that will not hold water.
early_warning: A water test of the tray alone would show the pinholes.
derisk: Test the tray before the screen is relied on as the seal.

circumstance: A laundry floor in a first-floor fit-out has no waste, and the only overflow path is into the tenancy below.
trigger: fitting out a laundry over an occupied tenancy
early_warning: The slab has no waste penetration on the survey.
derisk: Add a waste before appliances are specified.

circumstance: Screed falls in a pool surround drain toward the plant-room door rather than the waste.
trigger: laying falls around an existing pool
early_warning: A water test runs to the door.
derisk: Check falls before tiling.

circumstance: A new hydraulic stack through an existing sole-occupancy wall has no fire collar.
early_warning: The penetration is open around the pipe.
derisk: Collar every service before linings close.

circumstance: A fire damper cannot be installed because the existing duct is hard against the slab and there is no sleeve length.
trigger: inserting a damper in an existing duct
early_warning: The duct-to-slab dimension is less than the damper needs.
derisk: Measure the duct zone before the damper is ordered.

circumstance: An existing stair used as the exit for a new use is not fire-isolated from the storeys it serves.
trigger: changing the use of an existing building
early_warning: The stair opens directly into occupied floors.
derisk: Confirm isolation before the new use is documented.

circumstance: The product proposed to seal a gap at an existing slab edge is not tested for the gap width that was built.
early_warning: Measuring the gap would show it is outside the test.
derisk: Measure gaps and select a tested system before tender.

circumstance: A compartment wall in a tenancy fit-out stops at the ceiling grid instead of the slab.
early_warning: The wall head is visible at the grid and does not continue.
derisk: Take rated walls to the slab.

circumstance: A smoke door will not close because the existing floor is out of level and the leaf binds.
early_warning: A level survey at the door would show the floor fall.
derisk: Survey the floor before the door and closer are specified.

circumstance: Sprinkler heads in a new ceiling clash with the grid and end up too far from the wall they must cover.
trigger: setting out a ceiling with sprinklers
early_warning: The head spacing against the tile module does not meet the wall distance.
derisk: Coordinate heads with the grid before either is fixed.

circumstance: The existing booster cannot be seen from the brigade attendance point once the new entry canopy is built.
trigger: adding a canopy at the entry
early_warning: The sightline from the attendance point is blocked by the canopy.
derisk: Check booster sightlines against the new built form.

circumstance: There is no rated path for a new hydrant main through the existing building to the remote hydrant.
early_warning: The riser survey shows no spare rated shaft.
derisk: Find a compliant path before the main is designed.

circumstance: The smoke lobby is too small once both door swings are drawn on the existing plan.
early_warning: The swings overlap the lobby depth.
derisk: Draw the swings before the lobby is accepted.

circumstance: A detection zone crosses two compartments the fire strategy keeps separate.
early_warning: The zone schedule does not follow the compartment plan.
derisk: Match zones to compartments before the panel is programmed.

circumstance: The kitchen hood suppression does not cover the appliances the tenant actually installs.
trigger: fitting out a kitchen under an existing hood
early_warning: The appliance plan extends past the hood.
derisk: Match the hood and the suppression to the appliance layout.

circumstance: A late services bulkhead hides the exit sign the strategy relies on.
early_warning: The bulkhead depth cuts the sightline on the reflected ceiling plan.
derisk: Keep a sightline to every exit sign.

circumstance: Hose-reel coverage misses a room created by the fit-out partitions.
early_warning: The reel radius does not reach the new room.
derisk: Check coverage against the final partitions.

circumstance: A new bulkhead leaves a shadow in the sprinkler spray the existing heads cannot cover.
trigger: adding a bulkhead under existing heads
early_warning: The obstruction rules would flag the bulkhead depth.
derisk: Relocate heads or the bulkhead before tender.

circumstance: The existing sprinkler system is an ordinary-hazard layout and the new storage is high-piled racking.
early_warning: The racking height exceeds the existing design hazard.
derisk: Reclassify the hazard before racking is installed.

circumstance: The fire-pump room cannot be reached from outside without passing the area the pump is there to protect.
early_warning: The only door opens from the warehouse, not from outside.
derisk: Confirm brigade access to the pump before the upgrade is documented.

circumstance: Fire-water storage shares a tank with the potable break tank, and the fire volume is not reserved.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The tank detail has a single outlet with no reserved volume.
derisk: Separate the fire volume so other draw-off cannot empty it.

circumstance: Town-main pressure at the site is lower than the hydrant calculation used.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: A pressure enquiry or a site test would show the lower pressure.
derisk: Obtain the authority pressure before the pumps are selected.

circumstance: The pump duty cannot deliver the required pressure at the highest hydrant once the real pipe route is measured.
early_warning: The as-built route is longer than the calculation.
derisk: Recalculate from the route that can actually be built.

circumstance: A new cable tray passes through a fire-isolated stair the strategy treats as a shaft with no services.
trigger: routing a tray through a stair
early_warning: The tray is drawn inside the stair enclosure.
derisk: Keep unrelated services out of the stair.

circumstance: A lightweight rated wall is built with the wrong stud spacing for the system that was tested.
early_warning: The stud centres do not match the test.
derisk: Build the tested system, not a similar one.

circumstance: An existing timber floor cannot receive the ceiling system needed to rate it from below because the joists are too shallow for the lining build-up.
early_warning: Joist depth against the ceiling system would show the build-up does not fit.
derisk: Select a system the joists can accept.

circumstance: A smoke damper in an existing duct has no access panel, so it cannot be maintained.
early_warning: The ceiling type is fixed and there is no panel.
derisk: Provide access before the damper is accepted.

circumstance: The smoke-exhaust opening is partly blocked by an existing beam the smoke model omitted.
early_warning: The beam is in the opening on the structural drawing.
derisk: Coordinate the opening with the beam before the model is relied on.

circumstance: Make-up air for a new smoke exhaust has no path into the floor once the facade is sealed.
trigger: sealing a facade while adding smoke exhaust
early_warning: The exhaust quantity has no inlet.
derisk: Provide a make-up path that survives the facade work.

circumstance: A bridge added across an atrium cuts the smoke reservoir depth the fire engineering report assumed.
trigger: adding a bridge in an atrium
early_warning: The bridge soffit is inside the reservoir depth.
derisk: Keep the reservoir clear or revise the report.

circumstance: A fire door installed in a two-hour wall is rated for one hour.
trigger: hanging a door in a rated wall
early_warning: The door tag does not match the wall rating.
derisk: Match the door to the wall before it is ordered.

circumstance: A hold-open device releases, but the closer cannot latch the existing door because the frame is out of square.
early_warning: The frame diagonal would show it is out of square.
derisk: Repair the frame before the closer is relied on.

circumstance: The vision panel cut into an existing fire door is larger than the size the door was tested with.
early_warning: The panel size exceeds the door's test.
derisk: Keep the panel within the tested size.

circumstance: Smoke seals on an existing fire door miss the frame because the leaf has dropped.
early_warning: A paper test at the seal would show the gap.
derisk: Rehang the door before new seals are fitted.

circumstance: A dry sprinkler pipe in a freezer holds water because the grade falls away from the drain.
early_warning: A level on the pipe would show it cannot drain.
derisk: Grade the pipe to the drain.

circumstance: The valve set for a dry system will not fit the room beside the freezer it serves.
early_warning: The valve dimensions exceed the room.
derisk: Size the room to the valve set before tender.

circumstance: Racking installed after occupation is taller than the sprinkler design the warehouse was approved with.
early_warning: The racking height exceeds the approved storage.
derisk: Limit storage to the approved height or upgrade the sprinklers.

circumstance: A fire-rated duct runs further between compartments than the tested unprotected length allows, and there is no damper.
early_warning: The duct length between walls exceeds the test.
derisk: Add a damper or shorten the run.

circumstance: A cable tray through a rated wall is filled beyond the percentage the seal was tested for.
trigger: adding cables to an existing seal
early_warning: The fill exceeds the seal's tested percentage.
derisk: Reseal to a system that matches the fill.

circumstance: Intumescent paint will not bond to an existing member until rust is removed, and the thickness for the real section factor is greater than specified.
early_warning: The member size and surface condition differ from the specification.
derisk: Measure the section and specify preparation and thickness for it.

circumstance: Emergency lights spaced for an open plan fail once the fit-out rooms are built.
early_warning: The lux on the new path is below the requirement.
derisk: Space lights to the final path, not the shell.

circumstance: Battery packs for emergency lights sit in a ceiling that the fire strategy now treats as a rated void.
early_warning: The battery is drawn inside the rated ceiling.
derisk: Move equipment out of the rated build-up.

circumstance: Occupant-warning zones do not match the evacuation strategy for the refurbished floor.
early_warning: The zone schedule and the strategy name different areas.
derisk: Programme zones to the strategy.

circumstance: A warden phone cannot be cabled back to the existing fire panel because the riser is full.
trigger: adding phones to an existing panel
early_warning: The riser survey shows no spare conduit.
derisk: Find a path before the phones are specified.

circumstance: A hydrant landing valve clashes with the handrail, so the hose cannot be connected.
trigger: setting a valve in an existing stair
early_warning: The valve projection hits the handrail on the drawing.
derisk: Move the valve or the rail before installation.

circumstance: The rising main cannot be supported from the lightweight stair the design hung it on.
trigger: hanging a riser in a stair
early_warning: The stair is lightweight and has no member for the load.
derisk: Support the main from structure that can take it.

circumstance: The street hydrant the coverage plan relied on has been removed by the road authority.
early_warning: A site visit would show the hydrant is gone.
derisk: Confirm external hydrants before coverage is claimed.

circumstance: A fire-isolated passageway is used as a store, and the exit path is blocked.
trigger: occupying a building with a stored passageway
early_warning: Goods are in the passage at inspection.
derisk: Keep the passage clear in the management rules the design assumes.

circumstance: Smoke seals are painted over during a repaint and no longer seat.
early_warning: Paint is on the seal.
derisk: Mask seals before painting.

circumstance: A tenancy door the evacuation plan treats as an exit is under the neighbour's control and can be locked.
early_warning: The door is on the other side of the demise.
derisk: Give each tenancy an exit it controls.

circumstance: A lightweight fire wall is fixed hard to a steel beam with no deflection head, and the first load cycle cracks the lining.
trigger: building a wall under a steel beam
early_warning: The head detail has no slip joint.
derisk: Detail a deflection head under beams that move.

circumstance: A fire shutter drops onto a sloping existing floor and leaves a gap at one end.
trigger: installing a shutter on a sloping floor
early_warning: A floor level along the shutter line would show the gap.
derisk: Survey the floor and sill the shutter to it.

circumstance: The smoke-curtain recoiler will not fit the bulkhead the architect has drawn.
early_warning: The recoiler depth exceeds the bulkhead.
derisk: Size the bulkhead to the recoiler.

circumstance: A gaseous-suppression room in an existing building is not tight enough to hold the design concentration.
early_warning: A door-fan test would show the leakage.
derisk: Test the room before the agent quantity is finalised.

circumstance: The existing lath-and-plaster ceiling is not the rated ceiling the fire strategy names.
trigger: relying on an old ceiling for a rating
early_warning: Opening the ceiling would show lath and plaster, not the tested system.
derisk: Identify the ceiling build-up before the strategy relies on it.

circumstance: The firefighter lift is not on the power circuit that the fire strategy keeps alive.
trigger: connecting a lift to essential power
early_warning: The lift feeder is on the general board.
derisk: Feed the lift from the supply the strategy names.

circumstance: The refuge communication point has no cable path to the fire panel.
trigger: adding a refuge in an existing building
early_warning: There is no containment from the refuge to the panel.
derisk: Provide a path before the refuge is documented as compliant.

circumstance: Openings in an existing external wall are closer to the boundary than unprotected openings are allowed to be.
early_warning: The distance to the boundary is less than the unprotected-opening limit.
derisk: Protect the openings or increase the distance.

circumstance: Roof sprinkler hangers will not grip the existing purlin section.
early_warning: The purlin profile does not match the hanger.
derisk: Match hangers to the purlin before they are ordered.

circumstance: The foam system and the process water share a main the process can empty.
trigger: connecting foam to a process main
early_warning: The process draw-off is upstream of the foam reserve.
derisk: Reserve the foam water from the process demand.

circumstance: The existing fire panel has no spare loop for the devices the extension adds.
early_warning: The panel schedule shows the loops are full.
derisk: Confirm spare capacity before devices are added.

circumstance: A required vision panel in a rated wall is covered by a new brace.
early_warning: The brace crosses the panel.
derisk: Move the brace or the panel.

circumstance: An existing fire door scheduled for retention has hardware that is no longer made, and the closer cannot be repaired.
early_warning: The hardware model is obsolete.
derisk: Allow for a complete door set where parts cannot be matched.

circumstance: Penetrations sealed with a product not listed on the essential-safety-measures schedule cannot be shown as maintained.
early_warning: The schedule names a different system from the one installed.
derisk: Record the installed system on the maintenance schedule.

circumstance: A new intertenancy wall in a Class 2 building stops at the ceiling, and the plenum joins the two units.
early_warning: The plenum is open above the wall.
derisk: Continue the separation to the slab.

circumstance: The existing single stair discharges into the new extension rather than to open space.
early_warning: The discharge point is covered by the extension.
derisk: Keep a path to open space.

circumstance: The new supply duct will not fit the ceiling zone left under an existing transfer beam.
trigger: routing a duct under an existing beam
early_warning: The beam depth against the ceiling height leaves less than the duct needs.
derisk: Measure the zone before the duct is sized.

circumstance: The outside-air intake on an existing plant deck is closer to the kitchen exhaust than the separation requires.
trigger: adding an exhaust near an existing intake
early_warning: The distance between intake and exhaust is short of the required separation.
derisk: Separate the openings or extend one of them.

circumstance: The existing air handler cannot deliver the outside-air rate the new occupant load requires.
trigger: increasing occupancy in an existing floor
early_warning: The unit's fan curve is below the new outside-air quantity.
derisk: Check the existing plant against the new rate before the use is approved.

circumstance: Replacement cooling towers are heavier than the roof structure was designed to carry.
early_warning: The new operating weight exceeds the original plant allowance.
derisk: Check the roof for the replacement weight before the towers are ordered.

circumstance: Condensate from a new fan coil in a fit-out cannot fall to a lawful discharge.
early_warning: There is no fall from the unit to a waste.
derisk: Provide a pumped or gravity path before the unit is set.

circumstance: The tenant's kitchen exhaust has no riser in the existing shaft.
early_warning: The shaft survey shows no spare rated flue.
derisk: Secure a rated path before the kitchen is documented.

circumstance: Tenant condenser locations exceed the base-building allowance on the existing roof.
early_warning: The roof allowance is already used by other tenancies.
derisk: Check the remaining allowance before more plant is accepted.

circumstance: Heating pipework expansion in an existing corridor has no room for an expansion loop.
early_warning: The corridor width cannot fit the loop.
derisk: Find a loop location before the pipe is ordered.

circumstance: Plant vibration enters the structure because the flexible connections were omitted at the replacement air handler.
early_warning: The pipes are rigid at the unit.
derisk: Fit flexible connections at the plant.

circumstance: VAV boxes in a refurbished ceiling cannot be reached to commission them.
early_warning: The box is above a fixed ceiling with no panel.
derisk: Provide access to every box.

circumstance: Return air uses a ceiling void the fire strategy has now closed as a barrier.
trigger: rating a ceiling that was a return path
early_warning: The return path and the fire barrier are the same void.
derisk: Give the return air its own duct.

circumstance: Existing ductwork is lined with a material that has to be removed before the new supply air can use it.
early_warning: A sample of the lining would show it is not acceptable to retain.
derisk: Inspect linings before ducts are nominated for reuse.

circumstance: A replacement chiller will not fit through the plant-room door or the corridor to it.
trigger: replacing a chiller in an occupied building
early_warning: The unit dimensions exceed the smallest opening on the path.
derisk: Measure the access path before the chiller is ordered.

circumstance: The cooling load rises because the replacement glass is not the performance the plant was modelled on.
early_warning: The glass specification and the energy model name different products.
derisk: Freeze the glass performance before the plant is sized.

circumstance: Car-park exhaust discharges beside an openable window of the adjoining apartment building.
early_warning: The discharge is within the separation of the window.
derisk: Move the discharge clear of openings.

circumstance: Split-system condensate was never connected and stains the existing facade.
early_warning: The drain stops inside the wall.
derisk: Connect condensate to a lawful point.

circumstance: The existing flue is too small for the replacement boiler.
early_warning: The flue area is below the appliance data.
derisk: Check the flue before the boiler is selected.

circumstance: Plant noise at the boundary exceeds the limit once the replacement units are selected.
early_warning: The sound data at the boundary exceeds the condition.
derisk: Select plant that meets the boundary limit.

circumstance: A duct crossing an existing rated wall has no length of straight duct for a damper.
trigger: crossing a rated wall with a duct
early_warning: A bend is hard against the wall.
derisk: Provide a straight section for the damper.

circumstance: A balance damper sits above a fixed plaster ceiling with no access.
early_warning: The damper location has no panel.
derisk: Put an access panel at every damper.

circumstance: The existing riser is full, and the new riser duct for the extension will not fit.
early_warning: A riser survey shows no free area.
derisk: Find another path before the extension services are tendered.

circumstance: The coil handing on the replacement air handler is opposite to the existing pipe risers.
early_warning: The factory handing does not match the pipes.
derisk: Confirm handing against the risers before the unit is ordered.

circumstance: Chilled-water insulation is compressed at the hangers, and the vapour barrier is broken.
early_warning: The insulation is crushed at each clip.
derisk: Use a hanger that keeps the vapour barrier continuous.

circumstance: There is no straight pipe for the commissioning set on the replacement pump.
early_warning: Bends are hard against the pump flanges.
derisk: Leave the straight lengths the set needs.

circumstance: The existing cooling-tower structure is corroded below the size needed for the replacement tower.
early_warning: Thickness tests would show the loss of steel.
derisk: Test the support before the tower is ordered.

circumstance: An existing warm-water system cannot be disinfected to the regime the new occupancy requires.
early_warning: The system has dead legs that cannot be flushed.
derisk: Replace or alter the system so it can be disinfected.

circumstance: Outside air for a refurbished office is taken from the loading dock.
early_warning: The intake faces the dock.
derisk: Take outside air from a clean location.

circumstance: A sealed refurbished floor has no relief path, and the supply air over-pressurises the rooms.
trigger: sealing a floor during a refit
early_warning: Doors are hard to open once the fan runs.
derisk: Provide relief air.

circumstance: Windows that ventilated an existing classroom are sealed by the new facade, and no other air path is provided.
early_warning: The rooms relied on those windows.
derisk: Replace the ventilation the windows provided.

circumstance: A domestic rangehood duct is longer than the fan can push once the extension roof is included.
early_warning: The duct length exceeds the fan curve.
derisk: Check the fan against the real duct.

circumstance: Bathroom exhaust discharges into the roof space rather than outside.
early_warning: The duct stops in the roof space.
derisk: Discharge outside.

circumstance: Subfloor vents are blocked by the new extension slab.
early_warning: The vents are on the wall the slab covers.
derisk: Keep a ventilation path for the existing subfloor.

circumstance: A heater flue terminal on the existing wall is too close to a new openable window.
trigger: adding a window near a flue
early_warning: The terminal-to-window distance is short of the appliance requirement.
derisk: Move the window or the terminal.

circumstance: The refrigerant pipe run for a split system exceeds the length the selected unit allows.
trigger: running pipes to a remote condenser
early_warning: The measured run exceeds the unit's limit.
derisk: Select a unit for the real pipe length.

circumstance: Condenser air recirculates behind a new plant screen on a tight deck.
early_warning: Discharge air is drawn back into the same unit.
derisk: Keep the screen clear of the air path.

circumstance: The plant deck cannot drain both rain and the water the replacement coils shed.
early_warning: The existing drain is undersized for the combined flow.
derisk: Check the deck drainage against the new plant.

circumstance: A rigid conduit bridges the vibration isolators under a replacement fan.
early_warning: The conduit is fixed to both the fan and the slab.
derisk: Keep services flexible across isolators.

circumstance: Existing pneumatic controls have no points a new building-management system can read.
trigger: connecting old plant to a BMS
early_warning: The controllers have no electronic output.
derisk: Provide an interface or replace the controls.

circumstance: A temperature sensor is mounted in a supply jet and does not read the zone the occupants occupy.
early_warning: The sensor is in the supply airstream.
derisk: Place the sensor where it reads the zone.

circumstance: A smoke damper fails shut and there is no path for the smoke mode the strategy requires.
early_warning: The only air path closes in the fire condition.
derisk: Provide the path the smoke mode needs.

circumstance: The stair-pressurisation fan cannot make the pressure with the leakage the existing doors actually have.
early_warning: Door gaps are larger than the fan was selected for.
derisk: Measure leakage before the fan is ordered.

circumstance: A new plant room covers the lift-shaft vent.
trigger: building a plant room on a roof
early_warning: The vent is inside the plant-room footprint.
derisk: Keep the shaft vent open to outside.

circumstance: A car-park jet fan throws into a beam the airflow model omitted.
early_warning: The beam is in the throw on the structural drawing.
derisk: Model the beams that are actually there.

circumstance: An existing heater in the return path has to be removed, and the return then has no heater.
early_warning: The heater is in the only return path.
derisk: Replace the heating the removal takes away.

circumstance: Underfloor heating output falls because the floor finish changed from tile to a thicker timber.
early_warning: The finish resistance is higher than the heating design.
derisk: Match the heating to the finish that will be laid.

circumstance: A fan-coil drip tray holds water because the trap is on the wrong side of the unit's pressure.
early_warning: The trap arrangement does not match the unit.
derisk: Fit the trap to the unit's pressure regime.

circumstance: There is no dosing point on the existing closed-loop water the new coils connect to.
trigger: connecting to an existing hydronic loop
early_warning: The loop has no sample or dose point.
derisk: Add treatment access before new plant is connected.

circumstance: The expansion vessel is undersized for the water volume of the extended heating system.
early_warning: The vessel relief lifts when the system heats.
derisk: Size the vessel to the connected volume.

circumstance: An existing chimney is unlined and cannot take the condensing boiler proposed as the replacement.
early_warning: The chimney is masonry and the appliance needs a liner.
derisk: Allow for a liner before the boiler is selected.

circumstance: Combustion air for an existing plant room is drawn from a loading area that is not clean.
early_warning: The only louvre faces the dock.
derisk: Provide clean combustion air.

circumstance: Process extract from a new booth is connected to the general office exhaust.
early_warning: The booth duct joins the office riser.
derisk: Keep process extract on its own system.

circumstance: Process heat from new plant was left out of the ventilation design for the existing shed.
early_warning: The shed overheats when the process runs.
derisk: Include the process heat in the air quantity.

circumstance: Dust settles in an existing extract duct because the velocity is too low for the material the new process releases.
trigger: connecting a new process to an old duct
early_warning: The duct size is too large for the new flow.
derisk: Check velocity for the material.

circumstance: A dust collector's relief is aimed at a path workers use.
early_warning: The vent faces the path.
derisk: Relieve the collector away from people.

circumstance: The existing roof platform will not carry a refrigerated unit in place of an evaporative cooler.
early_warning: The new weight exceeds the platform.
derisk: Check the platform before the unit is ordered.

circumstance: A heat pump's defrost water has nowhere to go on an existing balcony membrane.
trigger: placing a heat pump on a balcony
early_warning: Defrost water ponds on the membrane.
derisk: Drain defrost to a point the membrane can take.

circumstance: Server-room cooling has no second path when the only unit fails.
early_warning: There is a single unit on a single supply.
derisk: Provide a cooling path that survives one failure if the brief requires it.

circumstance: Laboratory exhaust re-enters at a rooftop terrace the fit-out adds.
trigger: adding a terrace near an exhaust
early_warning: The exhaust is below the terrace.
derisk: Discharge clear of the terrace.

circumstance: Existing ducts cannot be cleaned to the standard the new clinical use needs.
trigger: reusing ducts for a clinical fit-out
early_warning: A duct inspection shows lining that cannot be cleaned.
derisk: Replace ducts that cannot be brought up to the use.

circumstance: A thermal wheel leaks exhaust air into the outside-air stream.
early_warning: A tracer test shows transfer across the wheel.
derisk: Select a wheel arrangement that suits the exhaust.

circumstance: Radiant panels clash with the sprinkler spacing on an existing ceiling.
early_warning: The panels sit in the spray pattern.
derisk: Coordinate panels and heads.

circumstance: An acoustic louvre reduces the free area of the boiler-room ventilation below the appliance requirement.
early_warning: The free area after the louvre is too small.
derisk: Size the louvre for both air and noise.

circumstance: Debris blocks an outside-air intake that was reused without a screen.
early_warning: The opening has no screen and fills with debris.
derisk: Fit a screen that can be cleaned.

circumstance: A garage exhaust fan is fixed to the floor structure of the bedroom above.
trigger: mounting a fan under a bedroom
early_warning: The fan is on the bedroom joists.
derisk: Isolate the fan from the room.

circumstance: An underfloor air plenum in an existing office is full of later data cabling and cannot carry the design airflow.
trigger: reusing a floor void for air
early_warning: The void is obstructed.
derisk: Clear a path for the air or duct it.

circumstance: Single glazing in an existing shopfront makes the heating load larger than the replacement plant can meet.
early_warning: The glass performance drives a load the plant cannot cover.
derisk: Decide whether the glass or the plant changes.

circumstance: A humidifier needs water quality the building supply does not have.
early_warning: The supply analysis does not meet the unit.
derisk: Treat the water or change the unit.

circumstance: Dirty extract from an isolation room joins a general riser.
early_warning: The extract duct joins the general riser.
derisk: Keep that extract separate.

circumstance: The refrigerant now required will not suit the grade of the existing pipework.
trigger: changing refrigerant in an existing plant
early_warning: The pipe specification does not match the new refrigerant.
derisk: Replace the pipe or choose a compatible refrigerant path.

circumstance: Acoustic-louvre depth uses the last of the plant-room floor the replacement chillers need.
early_warning: The louvre depth overlaps the chiller clearance.
derisk: Lay the room out with the louvre depth included.

circumstance: Welding exhaust in a new bay discharges beside the fresh-air intake of the existing shed.
early_warning: The extract is upwind of the intake.
derisk: Discharge clear of the intake.

circumstance: The existing switchboard has no spare ways and no spare rating for the fit-out load.
trigger: adding load to an existing board
early_warning: The board schedule is full and the demand calculation exceeds the rating.
derisk: Confirm spare capacity before the fit-out is tendered.

circumstance: The consumer mains cannot carry the maximum demand of the new equipment.
early_warning: The mains size is below the new demand.
derisk: Check the mains before equipment is ordered.
