circumstance: The supply authority's point of supply is not where the design assumed it would be.
trigger: connecting a new or upgraded supply
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The authority's plan shows a different pit.
derisk: Confirm the point of supply before the mains route is designed.

circumstance: New submains will not fit the existing riser once the other services are surveyed.
early_warning: The riser is full.
derisk: Survey the riser before the cable size and route are fixed.

circumstance: Voltage drop fails on the longest final subcircuit once the real route through the existing building is measured.
early_warning: The route is longer than the calculation.
derisk: Calculate voltage drop on the route that can be built.

circumstance: The existing ceiling zone is too shallow for the new cable tray.
trigger: installing tray in an existing ceiling
early_warning: The zone is less than the tray depth.
derisk: Measure the zone before the tray is specified.

circumstance: The breakers supplied do not discriminate with the upstream device.
early_warning: The curves overlap.
derisk: Select devices that discriminate before they are ordered.

circumstance: The earthing design relied on a metal water pipe that has been replaced with plastic.
early_warning: The pipe at the board is plastic.
derisk: Provide an earth that does not depend on the pipe.

circumstance: The existing switchroom is too small for the replacement board and the clearance in front of it.
early_warning: The room depth is less than the clearance.
derisk: Enlarge the room or choose a board that fits.

circumstance: The existing board has an asbestos backing and cannot be extended.
trigger: adding circuits to an old board
early_warning: The backing is a known asbestos product once the escutcheon is off.
derisk: Treat the board as asbestos and plan its replacement.

circumstance: The replacement generator will not fit the existing room or a flue path to outside.
early_warning: The set and the flue do not fit the room.
derisk: Measure the room and the flue path before the set is ordered.

circumstance: A photovoltaic array exceeds both the existing roof capacity and the export limit the distributor will allow.
trigger: adding solar to an existing building
early_warning: The roof check and the distributor's export limit both constrain the array.
derisk: Confirm structure and export before the array is sized.

circumstance: Lighting zones do not follow the rooms the new partitions create.
early_warning: One switch controls two rooms.
derisk: Zone the lighting to the final rooms.

circumstance: A late circuit has no spare conduit in the existing slab.
trigger: adding a circuit after a slab is cast
early_warning: The conduits are full or absent on the line.
derisk: Surface the circuit or core a coordinated path.

circumstance: The existing supply is single-phase and the new plant is three-phase.
early_warning: The meter is single-phase.
derisk: Upgrade the supply before the plant is ordered.

circumstance: A cable tray through an existing fire wall has no room for the seal.
trigger: passing a tray through a rated wall
early_warning: The wall thickness and the tray fill leave no annular space the seal needs.
derisk: Detail a penetration the seal can treat.

circumstance: A luminaire, a sprinkler and a diffuser cannot share the existing tile module.
early_warning: The three layouts do not land on the same grid.
derisk: Coordinate the ceiling before any one trade is fixed.

circumstance: The existing underground consumer main is undersized and its route cannot be proved.
early_warning: The main cannot be traced to a size that carries the load.
derisk: Locate and size the main before it is reused.

circumstance: A distribution board that serves more than one tenancy sits inside a tenancy the landlord cannot enter.
early_warning: The board is on the tenant side of the demise.
derisk: Put shared boards where they can be reached.

circumstance: The residual-current device trips on the electronic loads the tenancy connects.
early_warning: The leakage exceeds the device.
derisk: Select a device suited to the load.

circumstance: Harmonic current from the new equipment overheats a neutral that was not sized for it.
early_warning: The neutral runs hot under load.
derisk: Size the neutral for the harmonic current.

circumstance: The existing busbar has no spare tap-off for the extension.
early_warning: Every position is used.
derisk: Confirm a spare tap-off before the load is added.

circumstance: Starting the fire pump drops the voltage on the rest of the existing board.
early_warning: Other loads drop out when the pump starts.
derisk: Check the board against the pump start.

circumstance: Essential and general loads were combined on the existing board the fire strategy treats as separated.
early_warning: Essential circuits are on the general section.
derisk: Separate the supplies the strategy names.

circumstance: The generator flue discharges at an openable window of the existing building.
early_warning: The flue is within the clearance of the window.
derisk: Terminate the flue clear of openings.

circumstance: The generator fill point is inside the building, where a tanker cannot reach it.
early_warning: The fill is not on an external wall.
derisk: Put the fill where a tanker can reach it.

circumstance: An existing rising main passes through a stair the extension now relies on as fire-isolated.
early_warning: The main is inside the enclosure.
derisk: Remove unrelated mains from the stair.

circumstance: Floor boxes miss the workstation layout the tenant signs off after the slab boxes are cast.
early_warning: The boxes do not sit at the desks.
derisk: Hold the box setout until the furniture is agreed.

circumstance: The existing slab is too thin for the floor box the fit-out specifies.
trigger: cutting boxes into an existing slab
early_warning: The box depth exceeds the slab.
derisk: Choose a box the slab can accept.

circumstance: Lighting levels fail because the new finishes are darker than the calculation assumed.
trigger: selecting finishes after the lighting design
early_warning: Measured lux is low on the dark finishes.
derisk: Recalculate for the finishes actually chosen.

circumstance: Tall joinery blocks the emergency lighting on the exit path.
early_warning: The path behind the joinery is dark.
derisk: Check emergency lighting against the joinery.

circumstance: External lighting spills across the boundary beyond the permit.
early_warning: Light falls on the neighbour's windows.
derisk: Aim and shield the lights to the boundary.

circumstance: A lighting-pole footing clashes with an existing in-ground service.
early_warning: The service is in the footing on the utility plan.
derisk: Locate services before pole positions are fixed.

circumstance: An existing conduit is full and cannot take the new cable.
early_warning: The conduit will not accept the cable.
derisk: Prove spare capacity before the route is relied on.

circumstance: The only path into the existing board is an asbestos conduit.
early_warning: The conduit is a known asbestos product.
derisk: Plan a safe entry before cables are added.

circumstance: Photovoltaic conduit penetrates the existing roof membrane with no weathering.
early_warning: The conduit is a raw hole in the membrane.
derisk: Weather the penetration in the membrane system.

circumstance: Inverters derate because the existing room cannot reject their heat.
trigger: placing inverters in an existing room
early_warning: The room temperature exceeds the inverter limit.
derisk: Ventilate the room for the heat rejected.

circumstance: The main earthing conductor cannot be taken on a continuous route to the new electrode position.
early_warning: The route is blocked by structure.
derisk: Agree a continuous route before the electrode is moved.

circumstance: Equipotential bonding is missed in a new bathroom added to an existing house.
early_warning: Metal in the room is not bonded.
derisk: Bond the wet area.

circumstance: A lightning downconductor cannot stay separated from the power cables in the existing riser.
early_warning: The only riser already carries power.
derisk: Find a separated path to earth.

circumstance: The existing roof structure will not accept the fixing the lightning air terminal needs.
trigger: fixing a terminal to an existing roof
early_warning: The roof member is too light for the fixing.
derisk: Design a fixing the roof can take.

circumstance: The builder's supply is too small to run the plant during commissioning of an occupied refurbishment.
early_warning: The temporary board rating is below the commissioning load.
derisk: Size the temporary supply for commissioning.

circumstance: The existing private pole is unsafe to reconnect the upgraded mains to.
early_warning: The pole is split and the hardware is failed.
derisk: Replace the pole before reconnection.

circumstance: Metering does not follow the tenancy split the fit-out creates.
early_warning: One meter covers two tenancies.
derisk: Meter each tenancy on the supply it uses.

circumstance: The proposed sub-metering is not an arrangement the distributor will accept.
early_warning: The distributor's rules exclude the arrangement.
derisk: Agree metering with the distributor before tender.

circumstance: The cable supplied will not fit the lug on the breaker.
early_warning: The cable and the lug are different sizes.
derisk: Match terminations to the cable before delivery.

circumstance: The board's fault rating is below the fault level the authority now quotes.
early_warning: The quoted fault level exceeds the board label.
derisk: Confirm fault level before the board is reused or ordered.

circumstance: The existing board's fault rating cannot be proved from the label or the records.
trigger: adding load to an old board
early_warning: There is no rating on the board.
derisk: Prove the rating or replace the board.

circumstance: A new breaker does not coordinate with the existing fuses upstream.
trigger: adding a breaker downstream of fuses
early_warning: The curves do not coordinate.
derisk: Select a device that coordinates.

circumstance: A variable-speed-drive cable is longer than the drive allows, and the motor fails.
trigger: cabling a drive to a remote motor
early_warning: The cable length exceeds the drive limit.
derisk: Keep the cable within the drive's length or fit the mitigation the maker requires.

circumstance: Equipment in a hazardous area is not rated for the zone the process actually creates.
trigger: installing plant in a zoned area
early_warning: The zone drawing and the equipment rating do not match.
derisk: Match the equipment to the zone.

circumstance: Steelwork is not bonded across expansion joints, so the structure is not a continuous earth.
trigger: using steelwork as an earth path
early_warning: The joint is not bonded.
derisk: Bond across joints that break the path.

circumstance: Crane collector gear clashes with the new cable tray on the crane beam.
trigger: running tray along a crane beam
early_warning: The tray is in the collector envelope.
derisk: Keep the collector clear.

circumstance: An in-ground supply pit clashes with a new footing.
early_warning: The pit is on the footing line.
derisk: Locate the pit before footings are set out.

circumstance: An existing substation room does not meet the ventilation the transformer requires.
early_warning: The free area is below the transformer's requirement.
derisk: Ventilate the room to the transformer's needs.

circumstance: A high-voltage easement crosses the site of a proposed extension.
early_warning: The easement is on title across the extension.
derisk: Keep the building clear of the easement.

circumstance: A battery room cannot vent the hydrogen the replacement batteries can release.
early_warning: The room has no high-level exhaust.
derisk: Vent the room for the batteries.

circumstance: Joints in an existing rising busbar overheat when the extension load is added.
early_warning: A thermal scan shows hot joints.
derisk: Repair joints before load is added.

circumstance: The photovoltaic shutdown switch is not at the point firefighters can use.
early_warning: The switch is on the roof, not at the attendance point.
derisk: Place the switch where firefighters can reach it.

circumstance: Vehicle chargers push the existing supply over its limit.
early_warning: The demand with the chargers exceeds the supply.
derisk: Upgrade the supply or manage the charge load.

circumstance: The switchroom door opens across a required exit and reduces its width.
trigger: placing a door on an exit path
early_warning: The swing cuts the exit width.
derisk: Swing the door clear of the exit.

circumstance: A conduit cored through a post-tensioned slab hits a tendon.
early_warning: The tendon is on the scan under the hole.
derisk: Scan before coring.

circumstance: An existing mineral-insulated cable cannot be jointed to divert it around the new lift.
early_warning: The cable type cannot be jointed on site.
derisk: Replace the cable rather than divert it.

circumstance: A new cladding system covers the existing meter box.
early_warning: The cladding line passes over the box.
derisk: Keep the meter readable on the finished face.

circumstance: Common-area lighting is fed from a tenancy board.
early_warning: The common lights are on the tenant's circuits.
derisk: Feed common loads from a house supply.

circumstance: Kitchen equipment load exceeds the diversity the base-building board was sized on.
early_warning: The equipment schedule exceeds the allowance.
derisk: Size the supply to the equipment.

circumstance: Life-safety cable is not the fire-rated type for part of its route through an existing ceiling.
early_warning: A length of ordinary cable is in the route.
derisk: Keep the rating continuous.

circumstance: An existing lightning mast no longer covers the roof once new plant is added beside it.
early_warning: The plant sits outside the zone of protection.
derisk: Extend the protection to the new plant.

circumstance: A socket outlet in a refurbished laundry is inside the restricted zone around the tub.
early_warning: The outlet is inside the zone.
derisk: Place outlets outside the zone.

circumstance: A street-light cable is cut by a new vehicle crossing.
early_warning: The cable is in the crossing on the utility plan.
derisk: Locate the cable before the crossing is excavated.

circumstance: During cutover the old board is left without an earth while the new board is connected.
early_warning: The earth is lifted before the new one is on.
derisk: Keep an earth on every board that stays energised.

circumstance: A hospital imaging room's final subcircuit shares a board with a mechanical load that dips the voltage.
early_warning: The image fails when the mechanical load starts.
derisk: Give the equipment a supply that stays within its voltage tolerance.

circumstance: The existing main switchroom is below a wet area the fit-out adds, and the slab between them is cracked.
trigger: placing a wet area over a switchroom
early_warning: The crack is on the soffit above the boards.
derisk: Do not put a wet area over the room unless the slab is proved dry.

circumstance: Emergency lighting in a school hall is supplied from a local circuit the stage fit-out can turn off.
early_warning: The lights go out with the stage board.
derisk: Feed emergency lighting from a supply the stage cannot isolate.

circumstance: A new switchboard manufactured overseas arrives with devices that are not the ones the discrimination study used.
early_warning: The device list does not match the study.
derisk: Hold the study devices in the order.

circumstance: The existing sewer branch is too high for the new fixtures in the extension.
early_warning: The branch invert is above the fixture outlets.
derisk: Survey the branch before fixtures are set.

circumstance: A new soil stack clashes with an existing beam on the only available riser line.
early_warning: The beam is on the stack line.
derisk: Move the stack or the beam penetration before tender.

circumstance: Sanitary grade is lost because the existing slab is thicker than the survey allowed for.
trigger: hanging drains under an existing slab
early_warning: The soffit is lower than the long section assumed.
derisk: Measure the soffit before grades are fixed.

circumstance: A fixture trapped in a new internal room has no vent path back to the existing stack.
trigger: fitting out a room away from the stack
early_warning: There is no path for a vent.
derisk: Vent the fixture or relocate it.

circumstance: Water pressure on the top floor of an existing building is below what the new fixtures need.
trigger: adding fixtures at the top floor
early_warning: A pressure test at the outlet is low.
derisk: Measure pressure before fixtures are specified.

circumstance: An existing galvanised water service fails as soon as it is cut to connect the extension.
trigger: cutting into an old water service
early_warning: The pipe sheds rust and will not hold a joint.
derisk: Allow to replace the service, not just tap into it.

circumstance: The replacement hot-water plant will not fit the existing cupboard or a flue.
early_warning: The unit and flue exceed the cupboard.
derisk: Measure the space before the unit is selected.

circumstance: Tempered water cannot reach the new outlet within the pipe length the valve allows.
early_warning: The outlet is further from the valve than the limit.
derisk: Move the valve or the outlet.

circumstance: A trade-waste arrestor will not fit the level or the access the authority requires.
early_warning: The invert and the access path do not suit the authority's rules.
derisk: Agree the location before the arrestor is ordered.

circumstance: A new downpipe and the existing soil stack compete for the same riser space.
early_warning: Both pipes are drawn in the same shaft.
derisk: Give each pipe its own space.

circumstance: The existing combined drain cannot take the new sanitary load the authority will no longer accept on that line.
early_warning: The authority requires a separate sewer.
derisk: Separate the sanitary connection.

circumstance: A backflow device has no drain for its relief port.
early_warning: The relief discharges onto the floor.
derisk: Drain the relief to a point that can take it.

circumstance: Fire and potable water share a connection with no backflow split.
early_warning: The services join without a break.
derisk: Protect the potable supply from the fire system.

circumstance: A plant-room floor waste has no fall in the existing slab.
trigger: adding a waste to an existing plant room
early_warning: The slab falls away from the waste.
derisk: Form falls or move the waste.

circumstance: An existing stack leaks when the new fixtures are connected.
trigger: adding fixtures to an old stack
early_warning: The stack weeps at joints under the extra flow.
derisk: Camera or test the stack before it is reused.

circumstance: A balcony outlet is connected to the sewer rather than the stormwater.
early_warning: The pipe joins the sanitary stack.
derisk: Take rainwater to stormwater.

circumstance: The hydraulic riser is full and the new wet stack cannot enter it.
early_warning: The riser survey shows no room.
derisk: Find a path before the stack is documented.

circumstance: The water meter cannot be read without entering a tenancy.
trigger: relocating a meter during a fit-out
early_warning: The meter is inside the demise.
derisk: Put the meter where it can be read.

circumstance: A fixture below the sewer has a pump with no alarm and no storage.
trigger: draining a fixture below the sewer
early_warning: The pump detail has no alarm or well volume.
derisk: Provide storage and an alarm.

circumstance: The existing grease arrestor is undersized for the new kitchen.
early_warning: The fixture load exceeds the arrestor.
derisk: Size the arrestor to the kitchen.

circumstance: A hot-water ring cannot be balanced, and the last fixture in an existing wing runs cold.
early_warning: The end fixture does not hold temperature.
derisk: Balance the ring or reconfigure it.

circumstance: A dead leg left by a demolished fixture is longer than the plumbing code allows.
early_warning: The abandoned pipe is still connected.
derisk: Cut back dead legs.

circumstance: New press fittings will not seal on the existing copper, which is a size the fittings do not cover.
early_warning: The pipe diameter is not a current size.
derisk: Identify the pipe before fittings are ordered.

circumstance: An in-wall cistern clashes with the existing stud the wall cannot spare.
early_warning: The stud is in the cistern bay.
derisk: Open the wall and set the cistern to the framing.

circumstance: A wall-hung pan carrier has no solid fixing in the lightweight wall.
early_warning: The wall is lining on light studs.
derisk: Build the wall to take the carrier.

circumstance: Grab rails in an accessible toilet have no backing in the existing wall.
early_warning: The wall is hollow at the rail positions.
derisk: Provide backing before the rails are fixed.

circumstance: The shower mixer ends up outside the zone the new screen leaves reachable.
early_warning: The mixer is outside the screen.
derisk: Set the mixer and the screen together.

circumstance: An existing vent terminates inside the roof of the new extension.
trigger: building a roof over an existing vent
early_warning: The vent is under the new roof.
derisk: Extend the vent to open air.

circumstance: A stack vent is too close to a new openable window.
trigger: adding a window near a vent
early_warning: The terminal is inside the clearance of the window.
derisk: Move the vent or the window.

circumstance: An overflow relief gully is buried by the new paving.
early_warning: The gully is under the paving.
derisk: Keep the gully as the low point and keep it accessible.

circumstance: The authority sewer surcharges, and the existing building has no reflux valve.
early_warning: The authority advises the sewer can surcharge.
derisk: Fit a reflux valve that can be maintained.

circumstance: There is no serviceable position for a reflux valve on the existing drainage.
early_warning: The drain is under the slab with no riser.
derisk: Provide an accessible valve.

circumstance: Rainwater reuse is cross-connected to the potable supply.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The tank main joins the potable pipe without a break.
derisk: Separate the supplies.

circumstance: A non-potable outlet is connected as drinking water and is not marked.
early_warning: The outlet is on the drinking system.
derisk: Keep non-potable water separate and identified.

circumstance: Cooling-tower makeup has no backflow protection of the hazard the tower represents.
early_warning: The device hazard is below the tower.
derisk: Protect the supply to the tower's hazard.

circumstance: Trade-waste quality from the new process is outside the agreement with the authority.
early_warning: Samples exceed the agreement.
derisk: Treat the waste to the agreement or renegotiate it.

circumstance: A dilution pit will not fit under the process equipment it has to serve.
early_warning: The pit depth clashes with the equipment base.
derisk: Coordinate the pit and the equipment.

circumstance: An eyewash has no drainage and no tempered supply.
early_warning: The eyewash has no drain and is on cold water only.
derisk: Provide tempered water and a drain.

circumstance: A hose-reel tee on the potable main leaves the drinking water unprotected.
early_warning: The reel is teed off the potable pipe with no backflow device.
derisk: Protect the potable supply.

circumstance: A pipe is cast into an existing slab penetration with no sleeve, so the membrane cannot dress to it.
trigger: casting a pipe into a slab
early_warning: The pipe is tight in the concrete.
derisk: Sleeve pipes that must move or be waterproofed.

circumstance: A soil stack fixed hard to a bedroom wall is audible in the room.
early_warning: The stack is unlagged on the bedroom wall.
derisk: Lag and isolate the stack where it passes a bedroom.

circumstance: A stack bend has no clearing point that can be reached.
early_warning: The bend is behind fixed joinery.
derisk: Leave a reachable clearing point.

circumstance: The easement drain the house connects to is damaged and will not take the extension.
early_warning: A camera of the easement pipe shows it is collapsed.
derisk: Prove the outfall before the extension drainage is designed.

circumstance: Water hammer appears when new quick-closing valves are added to an existing main with no arrestor.
early_warning: The pipe bangs when the valves shut.
derisk: Fit arrestors.

circumstance: A hot-water relief valve discharges where a person can be scalded.
early_warning: The relief points at a path.
derisk: Discharge the relief to a safe visible point.

circumstance: A safe tray under a water heater has no drain.
early_warning: The tray has no outlet.
derisk: Drain the tray.

circumstance: An existing galvanised stack sheds rust into new fixtures.
trigger: connecting new fixtures to an old stack
early_warning: Rust appears in the new basins.
derisk: Replace the stack or line it before the fixtures are connected.

circumstance: Siphonic roof outlets miss the low points of the existing roof.
trigger: converting a roof to siphonic drainage
early_warning: Water ponds away from the outlets.
derisk: Set outlets at the real low points.

circumstance: A siphonic pipe cannot hold its height under the existing structure.
early_warning: Beams force the pipe below its design height.
derisk: Route the pipe where the height can be kept.

circumstance: A greywater system has no lawful place for the excess water.
early_warning: The site cannot dispose of the surplus.
derisk: Provide a disposal path before the system is specified.

circumstance: Laboratory waste joins the domestic sewer.
early_warning: The lab sink is on the domestic stack.
derisk: Keep laboratory waste on its own system until it is approved to join.

circumstance: An existing sewer rising main is at the end of its life and will not carry the extension.
trigger: adding flow to a rising main
early_warning: The main bursts under test pressure.
derisk: Test or replace the main before the load is added.

circumstance: The chemical-drain material is wrong for the chemical the process actually uses.
early_warning: The pipe data does not resist the chemical.
derisk: Match the pipe to the chemical.

circumstance: A tundish is hidden in a ceiling, so a relief discharge will not be seen.
early_warning: The tundish is above a fixed ceiling.
derisk: Put the tundish where a discharge is visible.

circumstance: Sprinkler test water discharges into a sanitary stack that is not sized for it.
early_warning: The test flow exceeds the stack.
derisk: Drain the test to a system that can take it.

circumstance: The water meter is downstream of a branch the new work needs to be upstream of.
early_warning: The new branch leaves the main before the meter.
derisk: Meter all the water the account must cover.

circumstance: An uncapped live main is not thrust-restrained when it is cut for a diversion.
early_warning: The cap has no thrust block.
derisk: Restrain the main before it is cut.

circumstance: The gutter outlet does not match the downpipe boss on the existing gutter.
early_warning: The boss and the outlet are different sizes.
derisk: Match the boss to the outlet.

circumstance: A stack in a shaft has no way to reach its joints.
trigger: building a shaft around a stack
early_warning: There is no platform or door.
derisk: Provide access to the joints.

circumstance: Recycled-water pipe runs unmarked beside potable pipe in a ceiling.
early_warning: The pipes are the same colour and adjacent.
derisk: Identify and separate the recycled pipe.

circumstance: A hospital pan-room flush system overloads the existing stack at the change of shift.
early_warning: The stack surcharges when the pans flush together.
derisk: Size the stack for the simultaneous flush.

circumstance: An existing trade-waste pit under a new driveway has no structural cover for the wheel load.
early_warning: The cover is a light lid.
derisk: Replace the cover for the vehicle load.

circumstance: A school drinking fountain is connected downstream of a non-potable tank without a break.
early_warning: The fountain is on the tank main.
derisk: Feed drinking outlets from the potable supply.

circumstance: The existing lift shaft is out of plumb beyond the guide-rail adjustment of the replacement lift.
early_warning: A plumb survey exceeds the rail adjustment.
derisk: Survey the shaft before the lift is ordered.

circumstance: The existing pit is shallower than the lift that meets the current access standard.
early_warning: The pit depth is short of the selected lift.
derisk: Match the lift to the pit or deepen the pit.

circumstance: Headroom above the existing car is short of the overrun the replacement lift needs.
early_warning: The underside of the slab is too low.
derisk: Select a lift the headroom can accept or raise the overrun.

circumstance: A modern accessible lift will not fit the existing shaft, pit and headroom together.
early_warning: No compliant lift fits all three dimensions.
derisk: Confirm a lift that fits before the upgrade is promised.

circumstance: The slab over a shaft was not designed for the loads of the machine-room-less lift now selected.
early_warning: The reactions differ from the original machine room.
derisk: Check the slab for the lift that will be installed.

circumstance: The lifting beam over the shaft was omitted, so the car cannot be installed.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: There is no beam rated for the car.
derisk: Provide a lifting beam before installation.

circumstance: Plant covers the shaft ventilation opening.
early_warning: The vent is inside the plant footprint.
derisk: Keep the vent open to outside.

circumstance: Landing doors clash with a new lobby bulkhead.
early_warning: The bulkhead is below the door head.
derisk: Keep the entrance clear of the bulkhead.

circumstance: The call button lands in a tile joint and cannot be fixed to a solid background.
early_warning: The button is on a joint.
derisk: Set the button on a solid part of the wall.

circumstance: The lift-pit sump has no lawful discharge.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The sump pump has nowhere to go.
derisk: Discharge the pit to a drain the system allows.

circumstance: Buffer fixings pierce the pit waterproofing.
early_warning: The bolts pass through the membrane.
derisk: Collar the fixings into the tanking.

circumstance: The existing lift machine sits on a timber floor that cannot carry the replacement machine.
early_warning: The floor is timber and the new machine is heavier.
derisk: Check the floor before the machine is ordered.

circumstance: The lift supply is not on the essential circuit the fire strategy requires.
early_warning: The feeder is on the general board.
derisk: Feed the lift from the essential supply.

circumstance: Running clearance is lost because the shaft was built small.
early_warning: The shaft size is inside the car's clearance.
derisk: Hold the shaft size to the lift shop drawings.

circumstance: A goods-lift door clashes with the dock leveller.
trigger: setting a lift at a dock
early_warning: The door and the leveller occupy the same opening.
derisk: Separate the lift entrance and the dock equipment.

circumstance: A platform lift has no landing clear of the door swing.
early_warning: The landing is inside the swing.
derisk: Provide a landing the lift and the door can share.

circumstance: The gap between an existing lift well and the floor slabs is not fire-stopped.
early_warning: The gap is open at each floor.
derisk: Stop the well at each floor.

circumstance: Escalator truss reactions miss the beams provided.
early_warning: The reactions fall between beams.
derisk: Place beams under the reactions.

circumstance: An escalator pit clashes with a transfer beam.
early_warning: The beam is in the pit.
derisk: Coordinate the pit and the beam.

circumstance: A moving walk cannot start until the slab-edge angle is recast.
early_warning: The edge angle is missing.
derisk: Cast the seat the walk needs.

circumstance: A hydraulic lift's oil line is buried in the slab and is leaking.
early_warning: Oil appears at the pit and the line cannot be reached.
derisk: Allow to replace the line, not just the seals.

circumstance: A security floor the lift does not serve has no shaft wall, only a missing slab.
early_warning: The floor opening has no wall.
derisk: Build a shaft wall at floors the lift does not open to.

circumstance: Two cars share a well with no divider where one is now required.
trigger: upgrading lifts in a common well
early_warning: The cars are in one open well.
derisk: Provide the separation the current lift rules require.

circumstance: The crane cannot land the lift equipment on the roof of the occupied building.
trigger: delivering a machine to a roof
early_warning: The crane radius does not reach the shaft.
derisk: Plan a delivery path the building can accept.

circumstance: A home-lift opening cuts more joists than the timber floor can lose.
early_warning: The opening takes joists in a row.
derisk: Frame the opening so the floor still carries its load.

circumstance: An existing lift lobby is too small for the accessible lift the upgrade requires.
early_warning: The lobby depth is short of the lift.
derisk: Enlarge the lobby or select a lift the lobby can serve.

circumstance: Vinyl tiles being lifted for a new floor contain asbestos.
early_warning: A sample of the tile and adhesive identifies asbestos.
derisk: Sample floors before they are nominated for removal.

circumstance: Ceiling sheeting above the new services contains asbestos, so the ceiling cannot be disturbed as planned.
early_warning: A sample of the sheet identifies asbestos.
derisk: Sample ceilings before services are routed through them.

circumstance: Eaves the new roof must lap to are asbestos cement.
trigger: tying a new roof to existing eaves
early_warning: The eaves sheet is asbestos cement.
derisk: Include the eaves in the asbestos scope.

circumstance: The heater being replaced has an asbestos cement flue.
early_warning: The flue is asbestos cement.
derisk: Remove the flue under an asbestos method, not as ordinary demolition.

circumstance: Gaskets in the plant being disconnected contain asbestos.
early_warning: The gasket material is asbestos.
derisk: Treat the disconnection as asbestos work.

circumstance: Lead paint is on the steel being cut for a new connection.
early_warning: A paint sample identifies lead.
derisk: Test coatings before cutting or blasting.

circumstance: Lead dust is in the ceiling void the new services must enter.
early_warning: Dust sampling identifies lead.
derisk: Clean the void before services are run.

circumstance: Capacitors in light fittings being removed contain PCBs.
early_warning: The capacitor type is a known PCB item.
derisk: Dispose of the fittings as the capacitors require.

circumstance: Loose insulation in the ceiling contaminates the area the new work needs clean.
early_warning: The insulation is unbound and fills the void.
derisk: Contain or remove it before other work.

circumstance: Mould is behind the lining of an external wall the fit-out would cover.
early_warning: The back of the lining is mouldy and the wall is damp.
derisk: Dry the wall before new linings are fixed.

circumstance: A ceiling below a burst stack is contaminated and cannot take a new lining.
early_warning: The void is soiled.
derisk: Clean the void before the new ceiling.

circumstance: Excavated soil is a waste the planned landfill will not take.
early_warning: Laboratory results put the soil in a higher waste class.
derisk: Classify the soil before the disposal path is assumed.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: Groundwater pumped from the excavation fails the criteria for discharge to stormwater.
early_warning: Samples fail the discharge criteria.
derisk: Test the water and arrange a lawful discharge.

circumstance: An underground tank still holds fuel under the slab the new building needs.
early_warning: The tank is found with product in it.
derisk: Remove or validate the tank before the slab locks it in.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: Ash fill under an industrial slab contains metals the new use cannot leave in place.
early_warning: Samples show metals above the assessment criteria.
derisk: Assess the fill for the new use.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: An old oil-filled transformer may contain PCBs and blocks the switchroom rebuild.
early_warning: The oil has not been tested.
derisk: Test and remove the oil before the room is rebuilt.

circumstance: Old thermostats being removed contain mercury.
early_warning: The devices are a mercury type.
derisk: Capture the mercury when they are removed.

circumstance: Smoke detectors being removed have a radioactive source and need a licensed path.
early_warning: The detector type contains a radioactive source.
derisk: Remove them on the licensed path.

circumstance: An old laboratory extract duct is still contaminated and cannot be opened for a new connection.
trigger: connecting to an old fume duct
early_warning: The duct history is a contaminated process.
derisk: Clean or replace the duct before it is opened.

circumstance: Bird droppings fill the roof space that has to be entered for the new services.
early_warning: The space is heavily soiled.
derisk: Clean it before workers enter.

circumstance: A ceiling void in a reused building contains biological waste.
early_warning: Waste is on top of the tiles.
derisk: Clean the void before services are run.

circumstance: Cutting the existing concrete produces silica dust in an occupied wing.
trigger: cutting concrete in an occupied building
early_warning: The cut is dry and open to the occupied rooms.
derisk: Control the dust before cutting beside occupied areas.

circumstance: Fire doors scheduled for new hardware have an asbestos core.
early_warning: The door construction is an asbestos core.
derisk: Do not drill the door; replace the door set.

circumstance: Adhesive under a timber floor contains asbestos.
early_warning: A sample of the adhesive identifies asbestos.
derisk: Sample the adhesive before the floor is lifted.

circumstance: Pipe lagging in the riser the new pipe must enter is asbestos.
early_warning: The lagging is asbestos.
derisk: Remove it or work so it is not disturbed, under an asbestos method.

circumstance: Debris on top of existing ceiling tiles falls into the room when a tile is lifted.
early_warning: Debris is visible on the tiles.
derisk: Clean above the tiles before they are lifted in an occupied room.

circumstance: Lead flashings have contaminated the soil below them.
early_warning: Soil under the drip line contains lead.
derisk: Deal with the soil as well as the flashing.

circumstance: Soil beside an existing house was treated with a pesticide that restricts how the spoil can be moved.
early_warning: The treatment record, or testing, identifies the chemical.
derisk: Classify the spoil before it leaves the site.

circumstance: Coal-tar pavement in the car park is a waste the ordinary recycling path will not take.
early_warning: The binder is coal tar.
derisk: Dispose of it on a path that accepts it.

circumstance: A former plating shop's slab still carries residue the new use cannot accept.
trigger: changing the use of an industrial building
early_warning: Residue is in the slab.
derisk: Assess the slab for the new use.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: An existing boiler door is sealed with asbestos rope.
early_warning: The seal is asbestos rope.
derisk: Remove the seal under an asbestos method.

circumstance: Refrigerant in the old plant is a controlled substance and there is no recovery equipment on site.
early_warning: The plant still holds refrigerant.
derisk: Recover the refrigerant before the plant is cut out.

circumstance: Mould in an air handler is spread through the ducts the new occupancy would use.
early_warning: The coils and ducts are mouldy.
derisk: Clean or replace the air path.

circumstance: Sediment in existing stormwater pits is contaminated and must be handled when the new connection is made.
early_warning: The sediment is not ordinary silt.
derisk: Test the sediment before the pit is opened.

circumstance: Drummed waste is buried where a new footing is set out.
early_warning: Drums are in the footing excavation.
derisk: Clear and classify the waste before the footing is poured.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: Insulation around an existing duct in a hospital ceiling is damaged and sheds fibres into a clinical space when it is moved.
early_warning: The insulation is unbound.
derisk: Contain the work before the ceiling is opened over a clinical room.

circumstance: The duct, the cable tray and the pipe all claim the one ceiling zone left under an existing beam.
trigger: coordinating services in an existing ceiling
early_warning: The three services do not fit in the measured zone.
derisk: Agree a single zone owner before tender.

circumstance: The riser on site is smaller than the coordinated drawing because the lining was ignored.
early_warning: The clear size after lining is below the services.
derisk: Coordinate to the lined size.

circumstance: A late hydraulic pipe misses the sleeve that was cast in the slab.
trigger: setting out a pipe after the pour
early_warning: The sleeve and the pipe are in different positions.
derisk: Hold one setout for the sleeve and the pipe.

circumstance: Two trades set out the same penetration in different positions.
early_warning: The hole and the service do not line up.
derisk: Issue one penetration drawing.

circumstance: A ceiling drops under a beam and the grille no longer fits.
trigger: coordinating a ceiling under a beam
early_warning: The beam zone is shallower than the grille.
derisk: Move the grille off the beam.

circumstance: A valve that must be maintained is blocked by a duct installed later.
trigger: installing a duct past a valve
early_warning: The duct crosses the valve handwheel.
derisk: Keep access to the valve.

circumstance: An access panel ends up inside a tenancy the base building cannot enter.
trigger: placing panels on a tenancy line
early_warning: The panel is on the tenant side of the demise.
derisk: Put panels where the party who maintains the plant can open them.

circumstance: The combined services drawing uses a structural revision that has been superseded.
trigger: coordinating to an old structural issue
early_warning: The beam sizes on the services drawing are not the current issue.
derisk: Coordinate to the revision being built.

circumstance: One service's bracket occupies the anchor another service needs.
early_warning: Two anchors are detailed at one point.
derisk: Share a bracket or separate the anchors.

circumstance: A fire collar and the pipe insulation cannot both fit the hole that was cored.
early_warning: The hole is tight on the insulated pipe.
derisk: Core for the collar and the insulation.

circumstance: A cable tray runs through the only access to a smoke damper.
early_warning: The tray blocks the access panel.
derisk: Keep the damper reachable.

circumstance: A light, a sprinkler and a diffuser cannot share one existing ceiling tile.
early_warning: The three devices do not fit the tile.
derisk: Coordinate the module before any device is fixed.

circumstance: A drain that must fall is blocked by a cable tray that cannot be notched.
trigger: crossing a tray with a drain
early_warning: The tray is at the level the pipe needs.
derisk: Give the pipe its fall.

circumstance: A condensate tray cannot fall because the duct is hard under it.
early_warning: The duct leaves no fall.
derisk: Set the unit so the tray can fall.

circumstance: A busbar and the sprinkler main want the same face of the riser.
early_warning: Both are drawn on one face.
derisk: Give each service a face and a branch path.

circumstance: Kitchen exhaust and fresh air are drawn in the same shaft.
early_warning: Both ducts are in one shaft with no separation.
derisk: Separate the exhaust from the intake.

circumstance: A wet-area set-down clashes with a post-tension tendon zone.
trigger: forming a set-down in a post-tensioned slab
early_warning: The set-down enters the tendon zone.
derisk: Keep the set-down out of the tendons.

circumstance: A duct clashes with a door head in an existing corridor.
trigger: routing a duct over a door
early_warning: The duct is below the head height.
derisk: Pass the duct above the head height the door needs.

circumstance: A duct bulkhead blocks the sightline to an exit sign.
early_warning: The sign cannot be seen past the bulkhead.
derisk: Keep the sightline.

circumstance: One oversized duct uses the whole corridor ceiling and leaves no room for the other services.
early_warning: The duct depth equals the whole zone.
derisk: Leave room for the services that share the corridor.

circumstance: Hangers from one trade hit the cast-ins of another.
early_warning: The anchors coincide.
derisk: Coordinate the fixings.

circumstance: A floor conduit clashes with the bars trimmed around an opening.
early_warning: The conduit is in the trim bars.
derisk: Move the conduit out of the trim.

circumstance: A wall chase for a pipe cuts the flange of a loadbearing stud.
early_warning: The flange is cut through.
derisk: Do not chase the part of the wall that carries load.

circumstance: Two wet risers are shown in a shaft that can fit only one.
early_warning: The clear shaft fits one riser and its clearance.
derisk: Provide a shaft for each riser.

circumstance: The ceiling grid is set out from the wrong grid and every penetration misses.
early_warning: Penetrations do not land on the tiles.
derisk: Set the ceiling from the same grid as the penetrations.

circumstance: Plant delivered to an existing plant room is larger than the coordinated footprint.
early_warning: The unit exceeds the layout.
derisk: Hold the coordinated size in the order.

circumstance: The coil-pull space of an existing air handler is taken by a new wall.
early_warning: The wall is inside the pull space.
derisk: Keep the pull space clear.

circumstance: A filter door opens into a new pipe.
early_warning: The door cannot open.
derisk: Keep the door swing clear.

circumstance: A pipe is run through the clearance in front of a switchboard.
early_warning: The pipe is inside the clearance.
derisk: Keep the clearance free.

circumstance: A sprinkler range pipe falls below a window head.
early_warning: The pipe crosses the glass.
derisk: Keep the pipe above the head.

circumstance: A drainage vent exits through the only place a curtain wall can stack.
trigger: penetrating a roof at a facade
early_warning: The vent is on the stack joint.
derisk: Move the vent off the joint.

circumstance: Roof cowls sit in the walkway to the plant.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The cowls are on the walkway.
derisk: Keep the walkway clear.

circumstance: A later cable tray bridges the isolators under a fan.
early_warning: The tray is rigid across the isolators.
derisk: Do not bridge the isolation.

circumstance: A shared bracket deflects and a drain loses its fall.
trigger: hanging a drain with other services
early_warning: The pipe no longer falls.
derisk: Stiffen the bracket so the fall remains.

circumstance: Seismic restraint clashes with the flexible connector at the plant.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The restraint locks the connector.
derisk: Let the connector move and still restrain the plant.

circumstance: A builder's work opening is round and the damper frame is square.
trigger: forming an opening for a damper
early_warning: The opening does not match the frame.
derisk: Form the opening the damper needs.

circumstance: Shaft lining is installed before the services, and the services no longer fit.
early_warning: The clear shaft is too small.
derisk: Line the shaft after the services size is fixed, to the clear size they need.

circumstance: An inspection opening for a stack is behind fixed joinery.
early_warning: The opening cannot be reached.
derisk: Keep the opening in front of removable joinery.

circumstance: A tank manhole ends up under a new stair.
trigger: building a stair over a tank
early_warning: The manhole is under the flight.
derisk: Keep the manhole reachable.

circumstance: A services support drops below the headroom of a path of travel.
early_warning: The lowest support is below the required headroom.
derisk: Keep supports above the path.

circumstance: A gutter sump and a smoke-exhaust fan housing want the same roof opening.
early_warning: Both are drawn in one hole.
derisk: Give each its own opening.

circumstance: A plant-room trench clashes with the thickening under a column.
early_warning: The thickening is on the trench line.
derisk: Route the trench clear of thickenings.

circumstance: Overhead-door tracks take the space a high-level duct needs.
trigger: coordinating a dock door and a duct
early_warning: The track and the duct clash.
derisk: Pass the duct clear of the tracks.

circumstance: A crane beam and a new cable tray occupy the same line.
early_warning: The tray is in the crane envelope.
derisk: Keep the tray out of the crane.

circumstance: A pipe rack crosses the swing of the only fire-egress door.
early_warning: The rack is in the door swing.
derisk: Keep the door and its swing clear.

circumstance: Holes in a precast panel were cast for a services layout that has changed.
early_warning: The holes do not match the current services.
derisk: Use the holes that exist or recast the panel.

circumstance: An acoustic baffle fills the return-air path.
early_warning: The return air cannot pass the baffle.
derisk: Leave a path for the return air.

circumstance: Joinery bulkheads are closed before the services inside them are tested.
early_warning: The pipes are concealed before the test.
derisk: Test the services before the bulkhead closes.

circumstance: An expansion loop fills the cupboard it was meant to sit beside.
early_warning: The loop is inside the cupboard.
derisk: Give the loop its own space.

circumstance: The services model uses a different origin from the site survey.
early_warning: Services miss the structure by a constant offset.
derisk: Share one survey origin.

circumstance: An office floor changed to a training room exceeds the live load the existing slab was designed for.
early_warning: The new use's load is above the original design load.
derisk: Check the slab for the new use before the change is documented.

circumstance: A warehouse changed to a public assembly has only one exit.
early_warning: The occupant load needs a second exit the building does not have.
derisk: Provide the exits the new load requires.

circumstance: An existing shop changed to a cafe has no grease arrestor and no path to install one.
trigger: changing a shop to a food premises
early_warning: There is no level or access for an arrestor.
derisk: Confirm a lawful trade-waste path before the use is approved.

circumstance: A house changed to a childcare centre has corridor widths below the new use.
trigger: changing a dwelling to a centre
early_warning: The corridors are dwelling width.
derisk: Widen the paths the new use needs or limit the use.

circumstance: Sanitary facilities are short of the number the new occupant load requires.
early_warning: The fixture count is below the load.
derisk: Add fixtures to the load.

circumstance: An existing mezzanine becomes occupied storage and has only one stair.
early_warning: There is a single stair.
derisk: Provide the exits the occupied mezzanine needs.

circumstance: The existing ceiling height is below the minimum for the new use.
early_warning: The measured height is below the minimum.
derisk: Do not adopt a use the height cannot support.

circumstance: Travel distance exceeds the limit once the new rooms are planned.
trigger: planning rooms in an existing shell
early_warning: The path is longer than the limit.
derisk: Rework the plan or add an exit.

circumstance: A performance solution for the old use is no longer valid for the new tenancy layout.
early_warning: The solution's assumptions are not the new layout.
derisk: Revise the solution before the layout is built.

circumstance: Energy-efficiency provisions are triggered by the alteration and the existing glazing does not meet them.
trigger: altering a building enough to trigger energy provisions
early_warning: The glazing is single and the alteration scope is large enough to trigger the provisions.
derisk: Confirm how much of the envelope must be upgraded.

circumstance: An existing stair does not meet the rise and going the new use requires.
early_warning: The going is short of the current limit.
derisk: Rebuild the stair or limit the use.

circumstance: The existing building has no accessible path to the new public use.
trigger: opening a building to the public
early_warning: Steps at the entry have no ramp.
derisk: Provide an accessible path where the premises standards apply.

circumstance: A bedroom added in a roof space has no second way out.
early_warning: The only exit is the stair.
derisk: Provide the exits the room needs.

circumstance: An existing factory changed to a place of assembly cannot show the structural adequacy the new importance requires.
early_warning: There are no drawings and no assessment.
derisk: Assess the structure for the new use.

circumstance: Fire-hydrant coverage does not reach the new occupancy at the rear of an existing building.
early_warning: The most remote point is outside the coverage.
derisk: Extend the hydrant system.

circumstance: An aged-care conversion of a motel has rooms that do not fit an accessible bathroom.
early_warning: The room size is below the bathroom layout.
derisk: Select rooms that can fit the bathroom or enlarge them.

circumstance: A laboratory conversion has no fume exhaust the existing shafts can carry.
early_warning: There is no spare shaft.
derisk: Provide an exhaust path before the laboratory is documented.

circumstance: The existing fire detection does not cover a new sleeping use.
early_warning: Detectors are heat-only or absent in bedrooms.
derisk: Provide detection suited to the sleeping use.

circumstance: An existing loading dock becomes the accessible entry and the grade is too steep.
trigger: reusing a dock as an entry
early_warning: The grade exceeds the accessible limit.
derisk: Form a compliant path or choose another entry.

circumstance: Waste storage for the new use does not fit the room the building has.
early_warning: The bins the council collects do not fit.
derisk: Size the room to the collection the use requires.

circumstance: An existing single stair in a three-storey walk-up is relied on for a new short-stay use it was not assessed for.
early_warning: The stair is not isolated.
derisk: Assess the stair for the new use.

circumstance: A legal point of discharge for an existing house is on a different boundary from the extension design.
early_warning: The authority's point is not the one drawn.
derisk: Confirm the point of discharge before the drains are designed.

circumstance: An existing street pit is not where the service plan showed it.
early_warning: The pit is found offset from the plan.
derisk: Locate the pit before the connection is designed.

circumstance: Kerb levels do not meet the existing ground floor, and the new entry needs a step the access design did not allow.
trigger: forming an entry to an existing floor
early_warning: The kerb and the floor differ by more than a compliant threshold.
derisk: Survey the kerb to the floor datum.

circumstance: Overland flow across an existing site is deeper than the floor level of the extension.
trigger: extending a building in a flow path
early_warning: The flow depth is above the floor.
derisk: Set the floor above the flow or redirect the flow on land the project controls.

circumstance: A neighbour's roof discharges onto the site, and the extension would block that water.
early_warning: Water from next door arrives at the boundary.
derisk: Keep a path for water that already arrives.

circumstance: In-ground pipes under a new extension slab are collapsed.
early_warning: A camera shows the pipe is broken.
derisk: Replace pipes before the slab covers them.

circumstance: A driveway crossing clashes with a street tree the council will not remove.
early_warning: The tree is in the only crossing position.
derisk: Move the crossing out of the tree's protection zone.

circumstance: New paving levels trap water against an existing house wall.
early_warning: The paving is above the damp course and falls to the wall.
derisk: Fall the paving away from the wall and keep it below the damp course.

circumstance: Services in the verge leave no corridor for a new stormwater drain.
trigger: laying a drain in a verge
early_warning: Locating the services shows no gap.
derisk: Prove a corridor before the drain is designed.

circumstance: An existing car-park slab holds water because it was cast without the falls the new coating assumed.
early_warning: A water test shows ponds.
derisk: Form falls the slab can accept or design the coating for the ponds.

circumstance: Downpipes on a reclad facade miss the existing in-ground risers.
early_warning: The new downpipes do not land on the risers.
derisk: Set the facade downpipes to the risers that exist.

circumstance: An extension roof overloads the existing house drains.
early_warning: The existing pipes are below the combined catchment.
derisk: Upgrade the drains with the roof.

circumstance: The survey benchmark does not match the architectural levels for an extension.
early_warning: The extension does not meet the existing floor.
derisk: Use one datum for the existing building and the new work.

circumstance: A subsoil drain behind a new retaining wall has nowhere lower to discharge.
early_warning: The site falls the wrong way for a daylight outlet.
derisk: Give the drain a lawful low point.

circumstance: A stormwater easement is not where the design thought the title placed it.
early_warning: The registered plan shows the easement through the building.
derisk: Plot the registered easement before the footprint is fixed.

circumstance: A hardstand falls toward an existing industrial building.
early_warning: Water runs to the wall.
derisk: Fall the hardstand to the treatment point.

circumstance: Rock in a trench forces a shallower grade than the existing council main can accept.
early_warning: The rock is above the design invert.
derisk: Prove the grade to the main before the pipe is ordered.

circumstance: A detention tank clashes with an existing footing.
early_warning: The tank is on the footing.
derisk: Separate the tank and the footing.

circumstance: Basement pump-out has no point the authority will accept.
early_warning: The authority will not take the pump discharge.
derisk: Agree the discharge before the pumps are designed.

circumstance: An existing crossover is too steep for the new basement ramp to start from it.
trigger: forming a ramp from an existing crossover
early_warning: The ramp grade from the existing crossover is too steep.
derisk: Redesign the ramp from the crossover that exists.

circumstance: Footpath crossfall is too steep for an accessible entry to land on it.
early_warning: The footpath grade exceeds the landing limit.
derisk: Agree a landing with the road authority or relocate the entry.

circumstance: A water main is not where the pit was designed.
early_warning: The main is in the pit.
derisk: Locate the main before the pit is set out.

circumstance: A new retaining wall footing would surcharge an existing council pipe.
trigger: building a wall over a pipe
early_warning: The footing bears on the pipe crown.
derisk: Keep the footing load off the pipe.

circumstance: A cut intercepts seepage that used to pass through the ground from the property above.
early_warning: Water appears on the cut face.
derisk: Collect the seepage.

circumstance: A boundary swale is drawn on the neighbour's land.
early_warning: The swale is outside the title.
derisk: Keep the flow path on land the project controls.

circumstance: The flood planning level changes after the extension floor has been documented.
early_warning: The current planning level is above the floor.
derisk: Adopt the level in force.

circumstance: An easement drain is too small for the roof the extension adds.
early_warning: The pipe cannot carry the combined flow.
derisk: Upgrade the pipe or reduce the catchment.

circumstance: A heavy-vehicle apron fails proof roll on an existing subgrade.
early_warning: The proof roll shows movement.
derisk: Design the pavement for the subgrade that is there.

circumstance: A truck path hits an existing column once the grid is set out on site.
early_warning: The swept path hits the column.
derisk: Clear the path of the columns that exist.

circumstance: A podium joint sits at a low point and ponds.
early_warning: Water sits on the joint.
derisk: Keep joints off low points.

circumstance: A bioretention area does not fit the setback the permit fixes.
early_warning: The treatment area is larger than the land left.
derisk: Fit the treatment to the land available or change the strategy.

circumstance: Saturated sand collapses a trench beside an existing building.
trigger: laying a pipe beside a building
early_warning: The trench will not stand.
derisk: Shore the trench.

circumstance: Cover over a new pipe is less than the wheel load of the existing driveway needs.
trigger: laying a pipe under a driveway
early_warning: The cover is shallow.
derisk: Lower the pipe or protect it.

circumstance: A rainwater tank volume was also counted as detention.
early_warning: The same volume is used for both duties.
derisk: Separate the reuse volume from the detention air space.

circumstance: A loading-dock yard is outside the range of the leveller the existing dock can take.
early_warning: The yard level is outside the leveller range.
derisk: Match the yard to the leveller or replace the leveller.

circumstance: A trade-waste line lies under a new driveway with insufficient cover.
early_warning: The pipe is shallow.
derisk: Protect or lower the pipe.

circumstance: Pit excavation beside an existing building exceeds the vibration the structure can take.
early_warning: The method is heavier than the building can accept.
derisk: Choose a method within the vibration limit.

circumstance: A boundary wall the design kept is rotating.
early_warning: The wall leans and has cracks.
derisk: Do not add load to a wall that is already moving.

circumstance: New fill behind an old boundary wall exceeds the load the wall was built for.
early_warning: The fill height is above the original ground.
derisk: Check the wall for the fill or replace it.

circumstance: An extra council pit inserts a level the pipe grade cannot meet.
early_warning: The extra pit breaks the grade.
derisk: Redesign the long section to the pit the authority requires.

circumstance: An empty detention tank would float in the groundwater found on site.
early_warning: The water table is above the tank invert.
derisk: Hold the tank down or lower the water.

circumstance: A yard interceptor is too small for the hardstand the extension adds.
early_warning: The pit volume is below the new catchment.
derisk: Enlarge the pit.

circumstance: Council footpath levels differ from the door threshold already installed.
early_warning: The footpath will not meet the door.
derisk: Set the door to the footpath the council will build.

circumstance: A shared driveway is too weak for the traffic the new dwelling adds.
early_warning: The pavement is a light residential section.
derisk: Upgrade the pavement for the new traffic.

circumstance: A crest blocks sight distance at the existing crossover the new use will rely on.
early_warning: The exit cannot see along the road.
derisk: Do not rely on a crossover that cannot see.

circumstance: Construction controls block the overland flow path through an occupied site.
early_warning: The controls dam the path.
derisk: Keep the flow path open.

circumstance: A silted culvert backflows into the site outlet.
early_warning: The culvert is blocked.
derisk: Confirm the culvert can take the flow.

circumstance: A transport authority refuses a drainage connection the design assumed.
early_warning: Consent is refused.
derisk: Find a discharge the authority will accept.

circumstance: An open channel on the boundary cannot be piped because it is the neighbour's flow path.
early_warning: The channel is required to stay open.
derisk: Keep the flow area.

circumstance: A gate blocks the longest vehicle the brief requires.
early_warning: The swept path hits the gate.
derisk: Set the gate clear of the vehicle.

circumstance: A pond the earthworks assumed could be filled is required to stay.
early_warning: The pond cannot be removed.
derisk: Redesign the levels around it.

circumstance: Truck wash water reaches the stormwater the design treats as clean.
early_warning: The wash falls to the stormwater pit.
derisk: Capture the wash before the stormwater.

circumstance: An optic-fibre protection slab is wider than the new crossing allowed for.
early_warning: The slab extends into the crossing.
derisk: Locate the slab before the crossing is excavated.

circumstance: A raingarden underdrain sits above the media and will not empty.
early_warning: The media stays wet.
derisk: Set the underdrain at the bottom of the media.

circumstance: Tailwater covers an outlet the design assumed was free-draining.
early_warning: The receiving water is above the outlet.
derisk: Set the outlet above tailwater or design for submergence.

circumstance: An existing on-site disposal system fails a new permeability test when the extension adds catchment.
early_warning: The soil will not take the extra water.
derisk: Redesign disposal for the soil and the new area.

circumstance: A retained tree's protection zone covers the only footing line for the extension.
early_warning: The zone covers the footings.
derisk: Move the footings or revise the tree outcome before tender.

circumstance: Dial-before-you-dig plans miss a live private electrical main across the yard.
early_warning: The main is found live and is not on the plans.
derisk: Locate private services as well as authority assets.

circumstance: An existing agricultural drain collapses under the new house slab.
early_warning: The trench is uncompacted.
derisk: Remove or compact the old trench before the slab.

circumstance: Finished site levels bury the damp-proof course of the existing house.
early_warning: The new ground is above the damp-proof course.
derisk: Keep finished ground below the damp-proof course.

circumstance: A soakage test for the extension fails in clay the house drainage currently uses.
early_warning: The test does not meet the rate the design needs.
derisk: Design disposal for the rate the soil accepts.

circumstance: The existing building encroaches over the boundary on the side being extended.
early_warning: The survey shows the wall over the boundary.
derisk: Resolve the encroachment before the extension builds on it.

circumstance: A shared downpipe serves the neighbour and cannot be moved for the extension.
early_warning: The pipe takes both roofs.
derisk: Keep the neighbour's roof connected.

circumstance: Existing roof drainage discharges onto the neighbour, and the extension would continue that discharge.
early_warning: Water leaves the site onto the adjoining land.
derisk: Bring the discharge to a lawful point.

circumstance: Floor flatness of an existing slab is outside the tolerance of the new finish.
trigger: laying a finish on an existing slab
early_warning: A flatness survey exceeds the finish limit.
derisk: Survey flatness before the finish is specified.

circumstance: Moisture in an existing slab is too high for the specified adhesive.
early_warning: The moisture test exceeds the adhesive limit.
derisk: Test the slab before the adhesive is chosen.

circumstance: Tile joints do not line up with the existing slab joints, and the tiles crack.
early_warning: The tile is continuous across the joint.
derisk: Break the tiles where the slab breaks.

circumstance: The junction between two new finishes is a trip on an accessible path.
early_warning: The lip exceeds the limit.
derisk: Keep the junction within the lip the path allows.

circumstance: A skirting bridges an acoustic joint and shorts the rating.
early_warning: The skirting is fixed to both sides.
derisk: Break the skirting at the joint.

circumstance: Paint is applied to a substrate that has not cured, and the film fails.
early_warning: The substrate is still damp.
derisk: Paint only when the substrate is ready.

circumstance: New paint will not bond to a chalking existing coating.
early_warning: An adhesion trial fails.
derisk: Prepare or remove the old coating.

circumstance: Joinery made to site measures taken before the lining does not fit the finished room.
early_warning: The joinery is tight against the lining.
derisk: Measure after the lining.

circumstance: A stone benchtop is thicker than the clearance under an existing window.
trigger: installing a benchtop under a window
early_warning: The stone hits the sill.
derisk: Measure the clearance before the stone is cut.

circumstance: New cabinetry covers the valves that must stay reachable.
early_warning: The valves are behind a fixed panel.
derisk: Leave access to the valves.

circumstance: A new door leaf binds because the existing frame is out of square.
trigger: hanging a door in an old frame
early_warning: The frame diagonals do not match.
derisk: Repair the frame or order the leaf to it.

circumstance: Door hardware clashes with the smoke seal.
trigger: fitting hardware to a smoke door
early_warning: The hardware cuts the seal.
derisk: Choose hardware that clears the seal.

circumstance: A service is screwed to a ceiling tile rather than to the grid or the slab.
early_warning: The tile is carrying the service.
derisk: Hang services from the grid or the structure.

circumstance: A bulkhead is smaller than the insulated duct it is meant to hide.
early_warning: The insulated duct does not fit.
derisk: Size the bulkhead to the insulated duct.

circumstance: Set plaster cracks where it crosses a structural movement joint.
early_warning: The plaster is continuous over the joint.
derisk: Stop the plaster at the joint.

circumstance: Tile lip in a wet area is large enough to pond water.
early_warning: Water sits on the high tile.
derisk: Keep lips small enough for water to reach the waste.

circumstance: Grout etches a natural stone floor.
early_warning: The grout is not the one the stone allows.
derisk: Use a grout the stone can tolerate.

circumstance: Stone thickness varies more than the bedding can take up.
early_warning: The pieces are outside the bed range.
derisk: Allow a bed that suits the stone supplied.

circumstance: A timber floor expands against the walls because the perimeter gap was not left.
early_warning: The boards are tight to the walls.
derisk: Leave the movement gap.

circumstance: The timber floor and the underfloor heating are a combination the warranties refuse.
early_warning: Both warranties exclude the combination.
derisk: Choose a floor the heating can sit under.

circumstance: Vinyl telegraphs the joints of the existing slab.
early_warning: The joints show through the sheet.
derisk: Prepare the substrate so the joints do not read.

circumstance: Stair nosings do not finish flush with the new floor thickness.
trigger: laying a floor up to a stair
early_warning: The nosing sits proud or low.
derisk: Set the nosing to the finished floor.

circumstance: A handrail bracket pulls out of the lightweight lining.
early_warning: The bracket is in the lining only.
derisk: Fix the bracket to structure or backing.

circumstance: A glass splashback is cut before the power points move.
early_warning: The cutouts miss the outlets.
derisk: Cut the glass to the outlets as fixed.

circumstance: A mirror cabinet is deeper than the wall and hits the door.
early_warning: The cabinet is in the door swing.
derisk: Choose a cabinet the wall and the door can accept.

circumstance: Wardrobe doors need a track the new ceiling build-up has covered.
early_warning: The track line is inside the bulkhead.
derisk: Leave a fixing line for the track.

circumstance: An operable-wall track deflects with the beam and the seals no longer meet.
early_warning: The track follows the beam deflection.
derisk: Check the beam against the track tolerance.

circumstance: The pocket of an operable wall is full of services, so the wall cannot park.
early_warning: Services are in the pocket.
derisk: Keep the pocket clear.

circumstance: A reception stone is larger than the lift and the stair of the existing building.
early_warning: The piece will not enter.
derisk: Check the piece against the access path.

circumstance: A decorative finish approved in the workshop does not match in the room's daylight.
early_warning: The sample on the wall does not match the workshop board.
derisk: Approve samples in the room.

circumstance: External paint is applied outside the conditions the product allows.
early_warning: The weather during application was outside the data sheet.
derisk: Apply the coating in the conditions it needs.

circumstance: Sealant stains the stone beside the joint.
early_warning: The stone is marked beside the joint.
derisk: Use a sealant that does not stain the stone.

circumstance: Tactile indicators will not adhere to the existing floor surface.
early_warning: The tactiles lift.
derisk: Bond-test the tactile on the surface.

circumstance: An entrance mat well is shallower than the mat.
trigger: setting a mat in an existing slab
early_warning: The well is too shallow for the mat to sit flush.
derisk: Deepen the well or choose a thinner mat.

circumstance: A mat well clashes with the existing door track.
early_warning: The well cuts the track.
derisk: Keep the well clear of the track.

circumstance: Loose furniture will not fit the existing lift to the tenancy.
early_warning: The piece exceeds the lift.
derisk: Check furniture against the lift.

circumstance: A compactus load exceeds the existing floor.
early_warning: The loaded weight is above the slab capacity.
derisk: Check the floor for the loaded compactus.

circumstance: Laboratory bench services are on the wrong side of the bench.
early_warning: The outlets face the aisle, not the user.
derisk: Set the services to the bench side that is used.

circumstance: A self-levelling epoxy floor ponds because it follows an existing slab with no falls.
early_warning: Water sits on the floor.
derisk: Form falls before a self-levelling finish, or accept the ponds.

circumstance: An accessible toilet is smaller than the circulation the standard requires once the existing column is included.
trigger: planning a toilet around a column
early_warning: The column is inside the clear space.
derisk: Plan the room around the column.

circumstance: Tactile indicators do not fit on the existing stair landing.
trigger: installing tactiles on a short landing
early_warning: The landing is shorter than the tactile zone.
derisk: Lengthen the landing or accept that this stair cannot take the tactiles as drawn.

circumstance: Handrail extensions will not fit the existing corridor width.
early_warning: The extension projects into the required width.
derisk: Redesign the extension to the corridor that exists.

circumstance: A door clear width is lost when fire lining is added to an existing frame.
early_warning: The clear width after lining is below the minimum.
derisk: Check the clear opening after the linings.

circumstance: An existing threshold step is higher than an accessible path can accept, and there is no room to ramp it.
early_warning: The step exceeds the limit and the run is too short to ramp.
derisk: Change the levels or the path.

circumstance: A required exit door opens onto a path the extension will enclose.
early_warning: The path beyond the door is no longer open.
derisk: Keep a path to a place of safety.

circumstance: A window sill in a child's room is below the safety height once the new floor finish is laid.
trigger: laying a floor under a low window
early_warning: The sill height from the new floor is too low.
derisk: Measure from the finished floor.

circumstance: The drop outside an existing low window is greater than the survey showed.
early_warning: The external level is lower than drawn.
derisk: Protect the opening for the drop that exists.

circumstance: A riser door swing cuts the exit width of an existing corridor.
trigger: swinging a door into a corridor
early_warning: The swing reduces the width.
derisk: Swing the door out of the exit width.

circumstance: Fire-brigade access no longer reaches the entry after the extension.
early_warning: The path is blocked by the new work.
derisk: Keep the appliance path.

circumstance: Finish build-up stops an existing door from opening.
early_warning: The door binds on the floor.
derisk: Undercut the door for the finishes laid.

circumstance: Sound flanks around an intertenancy wall through the continuous existing slab.
trigger: building a party wall on a continuous slab
early_warning: The wall tests below its rating.
derisk: Detail the slab and the wall so sound cannot pass around the wall.

circumstance: Back-to-back power points open a hole through an acoustic wall.
trigger: fitting outlets in a party wall
early_warning: The boxes are opposite each other.
derisk: Stagger the outlets.

circumstance: A ceiling plenum connects two rooms a new wall was meant to separate.
trigger: stopping a wall at the ceiling
early_warning: Speech carries over the wall.
derisk: Continue the wall through the plenum or stop the plenum.

circumstance: A duct through an acoustic wall has no lagging and links the two rooms.
trigger: passing a duct through a wall
early_warning: The duct is open between the rooms.
derisk: Lag or line the duct at the wall.

circumstance: Plant vibration enters a dwelling through a shared existing structure.
trigger: placing plant on a shared structure
early_warning: Vibration is felt in the dwelling.
derisk: Isolate the plant from the structure the dwelling uses.

circumstance: A soil stack is fixed hard to a bedroom wall.
trigger: fixing a stack to a wall
early_warning: The stack is audible in the bedroom.
derisk: Isolate the stack from the bedroom wall.

circumstance: The floor impact rating fails with the finish that was substituted.
early_warning: The test is below the rating.
derisk: Keep the finish the rating was based on.

circumstance: Glazing is downgraded and the facade no longer meets the external noise requirement.
early_warning: The glass is below the acoustic specification.
derisk: Hold the glass the noise requires.

circumstance: A door undercut cut for air ruins the acoustic seal.
