early_warning: The door no longer seals.
derisk: Do not use the acoustic door as the air path.

circumstance: Roof plant above a boardroom sits on a roof that is not stiff enough.
trigger: placing plant over a quiet room
early_warning: The room hears the plant.
derisk: Isolate the plant or stiffen the roof.

circumstance: Lift-rail noise transmits into a bedroom that shares the shaft wall.
trigger: retaining a lift beside a bedroom
early_warning: The bedroom hears the lift.
derisk: Isolate the rails from that wall.

circumstance: A garbage chute is fixed to the wall of a habitable room.
early_warning: The chute is on the room wall.
derisk: Separate the chute from habitable rooms.

circumstance: A garage-door motor is mounted on the wall of a bedroom.
early_warning: The motor is on the bedroom wall.
derisk: Mount the motor off that wall.

circumstance: An existing timber floor cannot reach the impact rating a new unit requires.
early_warning: The floor build-up cannot reach the rating.
derisk: Upgrade the floor or do not rely on it for the rating.

circumstance: A resilient mount is bridged by a tile or a skirting.
early_warning: The finish touches the structure.
derisk: Keep the finish off the isolated layer.

circumstance: The acoustic line of a facade is lost at the existing slab edge.
early_warning: There is a gap at the slab edge.
derisk: Continue the acoustic line to the slab.

circumstance: An acoustic louvre cannot meet both the airflow and the rating in the wall depth available.
early_warning: The depth is too small for both duties.
derisk: Increase the depth or reduce one duty.

circumstance: A studio slab on grade picks up street vibration.
early_warning: Vibration from the street is measurable in the slab.
derisk: Isolate the slab if the use needs it.

circumstance: A partition stops at a perforated ceiling and the room is not private.
trigger: stopping a partition at the ceiling
early_warning: Speech passes through the ceiling.
derisk: Take the partition to a barrier, or replace the ceiling.

circumstance: Existing single glazing faces a road the acoustic brief did not include.
early_warning: The external noise exceeds what the glass can reduce.
derisk: Select glass for the noise that is outside.

circumstance: A plant screen reflects noise toward the neighbour.
early_warning: The neighbour's level rises.
derisk: Place the screen so it blocks the path to the neighbour.

circumstance: Rain on a metal roof over a classroom is above the level the room needs.
early_warning: Rain noise is heard in the room.
derisk: Build up the roof to deaden rain noise.

circumstance: A riser door in an acoustic wall is a standard door.
trigger: installing a door in a rated wall
early_warning: The door is not the wall's rating.
derisk: Use a door that matches the wall.

circumstance: A bath is built against the neighbour's bedroom wall with no isolation.
trigger: setting a bath on a party wall
early_warning: The bath is hard against the wall.
derisk: Isolate the bath from the party wall.

circumstance: A cross-talk attenuator will not fit the duct branch between two rooms.
early_warning: The branch is too small.
derisk: Size the branch for the attenuator.

circumstance: The communications room is too small for the racks and the clearance in front of them.
early_warning: The room depth is short of the clearance.
derisk: Size the room to the racks.

circumstance: There is no cable path from the street lead-in to the communications room.
trigger: bringing a carrier into an existing building
early_warning: The path from the street is blocked.
derisk: Agree a lead-in path with the carrier.

circumstance: Existing containment is full and the new cabling has no route.
early_warning: The tray is full.
derisk: Provide a route before the cables are specified.

circumstance: Wireless access points clash with services already in the ceiling.
early_warning: The ceiling positions are occupied.
derisk: Reserve ceiling positions for the access points.

circumstance: The security head-end has no power on the essential supply.
early_warning: The head-end is on the general board.
derisk: Feed it from a supply that stays up if that is what the system needs.

circumstance: Door hardware is not compatible with the access-control lock.
early_warning: The lock does not fit the door.
derisk: Match the lock to the door and frame.

circumstance: Access-control locks on an exit path do not release when the fire alarm operates.
trigger: interfacing locks to the fire panel
early_warning: The doors stay locked in a fire test.
derisk: Release the exit doors from the fire alarm.

circumstance: A camera sightline is blocked by a new bulkhead.
early_warning: The camera cannot see the point required.
derisk: Keep the sightline or move the camera.

circumstance: The plant controllers do not expose the points the new building-management system needs.
early_warning: The required points are not available.
derisk: Confirm the points before the BMS is specified.

circumstance: Server-room cooling and the servers are on one board with no separation.
early_warning: Cooling and servers share one supply.
derisk: Arrange the supplies so cooling can run with the equipment.

circumstance: A raised floor is too shallow for both the airflow and the new cabling.
early_warning: The void cannot carry both.
derisk: Decide what the void is for.

circumstance: The communications rack earth is not bonded to the building earth.
early_warning: The rack earth stops at the rack.
derisk: Bond the rack to the building earth.

circumstance: Fibre bend radius is tighter than the cable allows at an existing riser turn.
early_warning: The turn is too tight.
derisk: Provide a radius the cable allows.

circumstance: A distributed antenna system cannot cover the lift and the basement.
trigger: providing radio in an existing building
early_warning: There is no coverage in the lift.
derisk: Design coverage for the spaces the structure shields.

circumstance: Nurse-call cabling has no path to the occupied rooms.
early_warning: There is no containment to the rooms.
derisk: Provide a path before the devices are specified.

circumstance: Medical gas pipe clashes with the structure above the bed head.
trigger: routing gas to a bed head
early_warning: The pipe and the structure occupy one zone.
derisk: Coordinate the bed head with the structure.

circumstance: Medical gas purity fails because the pipe was left open during construction.
early_warning: The purity test fails.
derisk: Keep the pipe closed and clean.

circumstance: A pneumatic-tube station clashes with a door swing.
early_warning: The station is in the swing.
derisk: Move the station clear of the door.

circumstance: A laboratory gas cabinet has no exhaust the building can provide.
early_warning: There is no exhaust connection.
derisk: Provide the exhaust before the cabinet is installed.

circumstance: Cold-room panel thickness uses the last of the room size.
early_warning: The clear room is below the brief.
derisk: Dimension the clear room after the panels.

circumstance: A cold-room floor step clashes with the accessible path.
early_warning: The step is on the accessible path.
derisk: Detail the step so the path still complies.

circumstance: A cool-room condenser in a ceiling cannot reject its heat.
trigger: placing a condenser in a ceiling
early_warning: The ceiling overheats and the room will not hold temperature.
derisk: Reject the heat to a place that can take it.

circumstance: A kitchen canopy is heavier than the existing roof framing.
early_warning: The canopy weight exceeds the framing.
derisk: Check the roof for the canopy.

circumstance: The gas valve and the mechanical exhaust are not interlocked.
early_warning: Gas flows when the exhaust is off.
derisk: Shut the gas if the exhaust is not running.

circumstance: A grease exhaust duct has no separation from a combustible ceiling.
early_warning: The duct touches the ceiling.
derisk: Separate the duct from the ceiling.

circumstance: A dock-leveller pit clashes with the slab thickening.
early_warning: The thickening is in the pit.
derisk: Coordinate the pit and the thickening.

circumstance: An overhead crane's collector is cut by a new partition.
trigger: building a partition under a crane
early_warning: The collector is interrupted.
derisk: Keep the collector continuous.

circumstance: A process drain is tied into the domestic sewer.
early_warning: The process waste joins the domestic stack.
derisk: Keep process waste separate until it is approved to join.

circumstance: A compressed-air pipe falls the wrong way and fills with condensate.
early_warning: Water collects in the line.
derisk: Fall the pipe to traps.

circumstance: A dust-collector explosion vent points at a path of travel.
early_warning: The vent faces the path.
derisk: Relieve away from the path.

circumstance: A public-address zone crosses a fire compartment.
early_warning: The zone does not follow the compartment.
derisk: Zone the paging to the evacuation compartments.

circumstance: A hearing loop does not work because of the existing slab reinforcement.
early_warning: The field is killed by the steel.
derisk: Test a loop arrangement the slab will allow.

circumstance: A satellite dish loses sight of the satellite behind a new screen.
early_warning: The dish is shadowed.
derisk: Keep the dish's sightline.

circumstance: An entry intercom is not reachable from the accessible path.
early_warning: The intercom is off the path.
derisk: Place it where the path can reach it.

circumstance: An existing nurse-call system has no spare capacity for the rooms the extension adds.
early_warning: The system is full.
derisk: Extend or replace the system before the rooms are added.

circumstance: Security cabling for a school upgrade shares a tray with power and picks up interference.
early_warning: The cameras drop out.
derisk: Separate the cabling from the power.

circumstance: A door that must fail safe on fire alarm has been wired to fail secure.
early_warning: The door locks when power is lost.
derisk: Wire the exit door to the function the fire strategy needs.

circumstance: The existing public-address amplifier cannot drive the extra speakers in the hall upgrade.
early_warning: The amplifier overloads.
derisk: Size the amplifier to the speakers.

circumstance: A data room's only cable path is through a fire stair.
early_warning: The cables are drawn in the stair.
derisk: Keep the cables out of the stair.

circumstance: An access-control reader is mounted on a hollow wall and the lock will not operate the existing latch.
trigger: fitting a reader to an old door
early_warning: The strike does not suit the latch.
derisk: Match the strike to the latch and give it a solid fixing.

circumstance: A planning condition requires a screen to plant that the construction drawings do not show.
early_warning: The condition is not on the drawing set.
derisk: Absorb the conditions into the documents before tender.

circumstance: The occupancy classification used for design is not the use the tenant will occupy.
early_warning: The lease use is a higher classification.
derisk: Design to the use that will occupy the building.

circumstance: The energy report assumes glass the order has changed.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The order and the report name different glass.
derisk: Hold the glass the report uses.

circumstance: The water authority will not allow the connection size designed.
early_warning: The authority limits the size.
derisk: Design to the connection that will be granted.

circumstance: The sewer authority moves the point of connection after the drains are designed.
early_warning: The nominated point has changed.
derisk: Redesign the drains to the current point.

circumstance: The power supply date is later than the commissioning programme.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The authority's date is after the programme.
derisk: Programme commissioning to the supply date.

circumstance: There is no gas main in the street the design connected to.
early_warning: The utility plan shows no main.
derisk: Confirm a main before gas appliances are specified.

circumstance: A live asset is found where the dial-before-you-dig plan was blank.
early_warning: The asset is live and not on the plan.
derisk: Locate assets before excavation.

circumstance: A registered easement is wider than the design allowed.
early_warning: The plan shows a wider easement through the building.
derisk: Plot the registered width.

circumstance: A street-tree protection zone covers the footing line.
early_warning: The zone covers the footings.
derisk: Move the footings or revise the tree outcome.

circumstance: Heritage fabric the design removed is confirmed as significant.
early_warning: The listing includes the fabric.
derisk: Keep the fabric and route new work around it.

circumstance: An adjoining owner refuses consent for a tie into the party wall.
early_warning: Consent is refused.
derisk: Design a support that does not need the tie.

circumstance: A crane over a road needs a permit the programme did not allow time for.
early_warning: The permit period is longer than the programme float.
derisk: Allow the permit duration.

circumstance: A road-opening permit restricts hours so the service tie-in does not fit.
early_warning: The permitted hours are shorter than the tie-in.
derisk: Plan the tie-in inside the hours.

circumstance: After-hours noisy work beside a residence is refused.
early_warning: The approval excludes the noisy activity at night.
derisk: Put noisy work in the hours that are allowed.

circumstance: A flood level is updated while the floor is being documented.
early_warning: The current level is above the floor.
derisk: Adopt the level in force.

circumstance: The bushfire attack level is higher than the design used.
early_warning: The assessment is a higher level.
derisk: Build the envelope to the assessed level.

circumstance: A balcony cladding product is not one the current external-wall rules allow at that height.
early_warning: The product is outside the rules for the height.
derisk: Specify a product the rules allow.

circumstance: An authority's reading of the access standard requires a larger room than drawn.
early_warning: The room is short of the size being applied.
derisk: Size the room to the standard as it will be applied.

circumstance: A fire engineering report assumes a management rule the tenant will not keep.
early_warning: The tenant's use breaks the assumption.
derisk: Do not rely on a rule the occupant will not keep.

circumstance: No approval can be found for the existing building the new work relies on.
early_warning: The record search finds no approval.
derisk: Establish the status of the existing building before the new work depends on it.

circumstance: Occupation is sought while a required service is not commissioned.
early_warning: The service has no commissioning record.
derisk: Commission the service before occupation is sought.

circumstance: A tenant's trade waste exceeds the agreement.
early_warning: Samples exceed the agreement.
derisk: Match the agreement to the discharge or treat the waste.

circumstance: A grease arrestor cannot be reached by the collection vehicle.
early_warning: The vehicle cannot reach the arrestor.
derisk: Place it where collection can occur.

circumstance: A stormwater quality target cannot be met on the land available.
early_warning: The device does not fit the site.
derisk: Change the strategy or the land used.

circumstance: An on-site detention outlet is larger than the authority will now accept.
early_warning: The required outlet is smaller.
derisk: Resize the storage to the outlet that will be accepted.

circumstance: Building over a sewer is refused.
early_warning: The authority will not consent.
derisk: Move the footing clear of the sewer.

circumstance: A protection slab over a sewer is thicker than the cover between the pipe and the finished level.
early_warning: The slab does not fit in the cover.
derisk: Redesign the levels or the protection.

circumstance: A substation lease area is larger than the room designed.
early_warning: The lease exceeds the room.
derisk: Size the room to the lease.

circumstance: A supply kiosk clashes with the entry.
early_warning: The kiosk is in the entry.
derisk: Place the kiosk where it can be reached and the entry still works.

circumstance: A carrier will not use the lead-in route designed.
early_warning: The carrier rejects the route.
derisk: Adopt a route the carrier will use.

circumstance: An airspace approval limits the tower crane below the height the structure needs.
early_warning: The approved height cannot reach the top.
derisk: Plan erection within the approved height.

circumstance: Excavation beside a rail corridor is restricted more tightly than the retention design assumed.
early_warning: The corridor owner's limit is tighter.
derisk: Design the retention to that limit.

circumstance: A licence limits the hours of noisy piling.
early_warning: The hours do not fit the piling duration.
derisk: Programme the piles inside the licence.

circumstance: A contamination cap the footing design cuts through must stay continuous.
early_warning: The footing punctures the cap.
derisk: Detail the footing so the cap remains continuous.
source: National Environment Protection (Assessment of Site Contamination) Measure

circumstance: A food premises needs a finish the existing wall cannot support.
early_warning: The wall will not take the finish.
derisk: Prepare a substrate the finish can be cleaned on.

circumstance: Cool-room condensate is classed as trade waste.
early_warning: The authority names trade waste, not stormwater.
derisk: Drain the condensate to the system named.

circumstance: The quantity of dangerous goods stored pushes the building into a different fire requirement.
early_warning: The quantity exceeds the amount the strategy assumed.
derisk: Match the strategy to the quantity stored.

circumstance: A neighbour dispute stops work on a party wall.
early_warning: Access is withdrawn.
derisk: Do not programme the wall work until access is agreed.

circumstance: An existing encroachment must be resolved before a new title can issue.
early_warning: The survey shows the encroachment.
derisk: Resolve it before the new work relies on a title.

circumstance: A strata committee withholds approval for work the lot owner has documented.
early_warning: The work affects common property and consent is not in place.
derisk: Identify common property and obtain consent before tender.

circumstance: A latent-condition clause does not cover the asbestos the tender documents said was absent.
early_warning: Asbestos is found where the report said there was none.
derisk: Treat clearances as limited to the areas sampled.

circumstance: Long-lead switchgear arrives after the date the programme gave the supplier.
early_warning: The manufacturing period exceeds the programme.
derisk: Order from the real manufacturing period.

circumstance: A specified membrane is discontinued before installation.
early_warning: The product is no longer made.
derisk: Name an approved alternative before tender or allow a substitution path.

circumstance: Wet weather closes the roof longer than the programme allowed, and the existing ceiling below is still open.
trigger: replacing a roof over an occupied floor
early_warning: The ceiling is open and the roof is incomplete.
derisk: Protect the occupied floor while the roof is open.

circumstance: A supplier's shop drawings use a different structural grid from the one being built.
early_warning: The grids do not coincide.
derisk: Review shop drawings against the current grid.

circumstance: An occupation certificate for part of a refurbished floor is sought while the shared stair is still a work area.
early_warning: The stair is not separated from the work.
derisk: Separate the occupied part from the work.

circumstance: A warranty inspection of balcony membranes fails because falls were not recorded before tiling.
early_warning: There is no fall record and the test was after tiling.
derisk: Record falls and test before tiles.

circumstance: The principal's existing-services drawings are marked for information and are wrong at the tie-in.
early_warning: The tie-in is not where the drawing shows.
derisk: Verify tie-in points on site before they are relied on.

circumstance: A provisional sum for unknown structure is too small once the strip-out shows the real beam sizes.
early_warning: The beams are smaller than the sum assumed.
derisk: Open enough ceiling before the sum is set.

circumstance: Scaffold for a facade repair cannot found on a slab that is still back-propped.
early_warning: The props are still in place under the scaffold load.
derisk: Found the scaffold on structure that can carry it.

circumstance: A hoarding footing clashes with a live service in the footpath.
early_warning: The service is in the footing.
derisk: Locate services before the hoarding is set out.

circumstance: A tower-crane base clashes with a permanent pile.
early_warning: The base is on a pile.
derisk: Separate the base from the piles that stay.

circumstance: The permitted crane cannot reach the far corner of the existing building.
early_warning: The corner is outside the radius.
derisk: Plan a method that reaches the corner.

circumstance: The loading bay is too small for the truck the replacement facade needs.
early_warning: The panel truck does not fit.
derisk: Size the bay to the delivery.

circumstance: Edge protection cannot be fixed where the facade bracket must go.
early_warning: The protection and the bracket occupy one zone.
derisk: Sequence the protection so the edge stays safe.

circumstance: The formwork system cannot make the slab profile the architect has drawn.
early_warning: The profile is beyond the system.
derisk: Detail a profile the formwork can make.

circumstance: Back-propping through a finished tenancy is refused.
trigger: pouring a slab over an occupied floor
early_warning: The tenancy will not accept props.
derisk: Plan a pour sequence the floor below can accept.

circumstance: Temporary waterproofing fails and floods finished levels below.
early_warning: Water reaches the finished floor.
derisk: Keep water out of finished floors while the deck is open.

circumstance: The site ramp is steeper than the delivery vehicles can climb.
early_warning: The grade is too steep.
derisk: Form a ramp the vehicles can use.

circumstance: A crane tie lands on a slab edge the permanent facade detail needs.
early_warning: The tie is in the facade zone.
derisk: Place the tie where the facade can still be completed.

circumstance: The materials hoist cannot take the plasterboard packs.
early_warning: The pack does not fit the hoist.
derisk: Choose a hoist the materials fit.

circumstance: A swing stage cannot be founded because roof plant occupies the davit zone.
early_warning: The davit zone is full of plant.
derisk: Free a davit zone or choose another access method.

circumstance: The excavation ramp clashes with the first footing.
early_warning: The ramp occupies a footing.
derisk: Sequence the ramp so the footing can be built.

circumstance: The temporary power board is in the zone of the permanent switchroom.
early_warning: The temporary board is where the permanent room must be.
derisk: Move the temporary board before the room is built.

circumstance: Scaffold ties do not land on structure because the precast joints are in the way.
early_warning: The ties hit joints.
derisk: Land ties on structure.

circumstance: Needles for underpinning clash with a live flue in the wall.
early_warning: The flue is in the needle line.
derisk: Locate flues before needles are set out.

circumstance: A crash deck over a footpath cannot hold the facade piece being fixed above it.
early_warning: The piece is heavier than the deck.
derisk: Design the deck for the piece.

circumstance: A temporary stair lands in the clearance of a permanent fire door.
early_warning: The stair is in the door clearance.
derisk: Move the stair before the clearance is measured.

circumstance: Dewatering discharge exceeds the volume the permit allows.
early_warning: The pumped volume is above the permit.
derisk: Keep the discharge inside the permit or amend it.

circumstance: A retained ceiling is supporting live services that the strip-out would drop.
early_warning: Cables are tied to the ceiling being removed.
derisk: Support the services before the ceiling goes.

circumstance: Demolition of a wall starts before the services in it are proved dead.
early_warning: A cable in the wall is still live.
derisk: Prove services dead or divert them before demolition.

circumstance: A protection screen to an occupied floor is omitted while the floor above is stripped.
early_warning: Debris can fall to the floor below.
derisk: Separate the strip-out from the occupied floor.

circumstance: The only exit stair is closed by the work while the building stays occupied.
early_warning: The stair is the only exit and it is a work zone.
derisk: Keep an exit available.

circumstance: Out-of-hours noisy work runs longer than the agreement with the occupants.
early_warning: The noisy task exceeds the agreed window.
derisk: Match the task to the window.

circumstance: Protection of existing finishes fails and the area has to be redone.
early_warning: The finishes to remain are damaged.
derisk: Isolate the work from finishes that stay.

circumstance: A cutover window agreed with the occupant is shorter than the services changeover needs.
early_warning: The window is too short for the changeover.
derisk: Agree a window the changeover can finish in.

circumstance: A shared riser cannot be opened because another tenant will not give access.
early_warning: Access is refused.
derisk: Secure access before the riser work is programmed.

circumstance: Existing plant has no isolation, so the new plant cannot be cut over live.
early_warning: There are no isolation valves or switches.
derisk: Provide isolation before the cutover is planned.

circumstance: Record drawings do not match the building at the point the new work must connect.
early_warning: The member on site is not the one on the drawing.
derisk: Verify the connection point on site.

circumstance: A hidden beam is found where a new opening was planned.
early_warning: The beam is exposed when the ceiling comes down.
derisk: Open the ceiling on the opening line before the opening is tendered.

circumstance: An existing floor level differs from the survey by more than the new work can absorb.
trigger: setting out new work to an existing floor
early_warning: The junction does not meet.
derisk: Survey the level at the junction.

circumstance: An existing wall is out of plumb by more than the new lining can absorb.
early_warning: The cavity is lost on the high side.
derisk: Survey plumb before the lining system is chosen.

circumstance: A wall marked non-structural on the demolition plan is holding the floor above.
early_warning: Joists bear on the wall.
derisk: Prove the load path before the wall is demolished.

circumstance: The existing ceiling grid is a different module from the new tiles.
early_warning: The tiles do not fit the grid.
derisk: Match the tile to the grid or replace the grid.

circumstance: An existing membrane is cut by a new penetration and is not made good.
early_warning: The hole is open in the membrane.
derisk: Make the membrane good at every new hole.

circumstance: Joists run the opposite way to the assumption, and a new opening cuts them all.
trigger: cutting an opening in a timber floor
early_warning: The joists run into the opening.
derisk: Confirm direction before the opening is cut.

circumstance: A party wall is not on the line the title shows.
early_warning: The survey and the title do not agree.
derisk: Survey the wall against the title.

circumstance: Windows being retained do not meet the safety or energy requirement of the new use.
early_warning: The windows are ordinary glass and single glazed.
derisk: Upgrade the windows the new use requires.

circumstance: An existing balcony drains toward the new door.
trigger: forming a door onto a balcony
early_warning: The falls run to the door position.
derisk: Rebuild the falls or set the door above them.

circumstance: Subfloor clearance is too small to run the new services.
early_warning: The clearance is below the services.
derisk: Choose a route the subfloor can take.

circumstance: Bearer ends built into an external wall are decayed.
early_warning: The ends are soft.
derisk: Expose and repair the bearings.

circumstance: There is no walkway in the roof space, and the ceiling cannot be used as one.
early_warning: Workers would have to stand on the ceiling.
derisk: Provide a path that is not the ceiling.

circumstance: Insulation fills the roof space a new unit needs.
trigger: placing a unit in a roof
early_warning: There is no clear space.
derisk: Clear a space or locate the unit elsewhere.

circumstance: A chimney that is structural is shown as removable.
early_warning: Floors bear on the chimney.
derisk: Prove the chimney is not holding the floors.

circumstance: A neighbour's flue is in the party wall on the line of a new opening.
early_warning: The flue is live in the wall.
derisk: Locate flues before openings are cut.

circumstance: Lath-and-plaster ceilings collapse when services above them are moved.
early_warning: The ceiling is fragile.
derisk: Protect or replace the ceiling before the services move.

circumstance: Existing plaster dusts and will not take a new coating.
early_warning: The plaster is loose.
derisk: Repair the substrate before coating.

circumstance: Tiles on a wet wall come off with the membrane behind them.
early_warning: The membrane comes with the tile.
derisk: Allow to replace the membrane.

circumstance: An existing balustrade is below the current height.
early_warning: The height is short of the current requirement.
derisk: Raise or replace the balustrade if the work requires it.

circumstance: Glass in an existing balustrade is not safety glass.
early_warning: The glass is unmarked.
derisk: Replace glass that guards a fall if it is not safety glass.

circumstance: An existing roof sheet cannot be walked and there is no other access for the coating.
early_warning: The sheet will not carry a person.
derisk: Provide access that does not load the sheet.

circumstance: Existing purlin spacing suits no current roof sheet.
early_warning: The spacing exceeds current span tables.
derisk: Add purlins or choose a sheet that spans them.

circumstance: An operating crane remains on the runway the new work must alter.
early_warning: The crane is still in service.
derisk: Agree a shutdown before the runway is altered.

circumstance: The only process shutdown is shorter than the services tie-in.
early_warning: The shutdown window is too short.
derisk: Design a tie-in that fits the shutdown.

circumstance: Existing slab joints do not line up with the new forklift aisles.
early_warning: The joints are in the wheel path.
derisk: Set aisles off the joints or detail the joints for the wheels.

circumstance: A control joint in an existing slab has been filled solid.
early_warning: The joint is rigid.
derisk: Reinstate a joint that can move.

circumstance: An existing pit is larger than the cover the new layout needs, and forklifts must cross it.
early_warning: The cover is not rated for the wheel load.
derisk: Cover the pit for the load that will cross it.

circumstance: Underground process lines are not on any drawing and cross a new footing.
early_warning: A live line is in the footing.
derisk: Locate process lines before footings are excavated.

circumstance: An existing bund no longer holds the volume of the tank it serves.
early_warning: The bund volume is below the tank.
derisk: Resize the bund to the tank.

circumstance: A previous addition has no approval, and the new work depends on it.
early_warning: No approval is on the record.
derisk: Regularise the addition or do not rely on it.

circumstance: The existing building is not square to the new grid.
early_warning: The extension does not meet the existing walls.
derisk: Set out to the building that exists.

circumstance: A double-brick wall is full of rubble, and the new fixing does not hold.
early_warning: The fixing pulls out of a void.
derisk: Fix into a solid leaf.

circumstance: A timber lintel over an existing window is failing.
early_warning: The lintel is cracked and the brick has dropped.
derisk: Replace the lintel before the opening is relied on.

circumstance: An existing floor falls more than a rigid new finish can follow.
early_warning: The fall exceeds the finish tolerance.
derisk: Level the floor or choose a finish that can follow it.

circumstance: Existing door frames are out of square and the new leaves will not fit.
early_warning: The leaves do not fit the frames.
derisk: Survey the frames before the leaves are made.

circumstance: Existing glazing is wired glass the new screen system cannot accept.
early_warning: The glass is not the type the system holds.
derisk: Replace the glass with a type the system can hold.

circumstance: A previous injection treatment of a basement wall has failed and the wall is still saturated.
early_warning: The wall is wet behind the old injection.
derisk: Stop the water before lining.

circumstance: The only sump discharges to a blocked line.
early_warning: The outfall does not flow.
derisk: Clear or replace the outfall.

circumstance: An old oil tank still occupies the plant room the new boilers need.
early_warning: The tank is in the room.
derisk: Remove the tank before the boilers are planned into the room.

circumstance: The only route for new plant is an existing corridor that is too narrow.
early_warning: The plant will not pass the corridor.
derisk: Choose plant that can pass, or open a route.

circumstance: An existing movement joint has seized.
early_warning: The joint no longer moves.
derisk: Free the joint or design for the fact it has seized.

circumstance: A floor topping hides services nobody knew were there.
early_warning: Conduits are in the topping.
derisk: Scan the topping before it is removed.

circumstance: A bonded stone finish cannot be saved when the substrate is repaired.
early_warning: The stone comes off with the repair.
derisk: Allow to replace the finish.

circumstance: Heritage fabric must stay, and the new services have no other route.
early_warning: Every route cuts listed fabric.
derisk: Find a path that does not cut the fabric.

circumstance: An ornate ceiling is below a bathroom that leaks.
trigger: keeping a ceiling under a wet area
early_warning: The ceiling is stained under the bathroom.
derisk: Repair the wet area before the ceiling is conserved.

circumstance: The existing roof falls the wrong way for the new membrane.
early_warning: The falls do not reach the outlets.
derisk: Correct the falls or move the outlets.

circumstance: An existing slab is thicker than surveyed, and the new floor build-up does not fit the storey height.
early_warning: The remaining height is below the build-up.
derisk: Measure the slab and the storey together.

circumstance: Concrete cancer is worse once the covering is removed.
early_warning: The steel loss is greater than the surface suggested.
derisk: Allow the repair to grow once the covering is off.

circumstance: A reinforcement scan shows bars are not where a new opening needs them to be absent.
early_warning: The bars are in the opening.
derisk: Move the opening to a place the scan allows.

circumstance: An existing switchroom below a new wet area has a cracked slab between them.
trigger: placing a wet area over a switchroom
early_warning: The soffit is cracked.
derisk: Do not rely on the slab to keep the room dry.

circumstance: A hospital ward cannot be decanted for the duration the services replacement needs.
early_warning: The ward must stay in use.
derisk: Stage the work to the decant the hospital can give.

circumstance: Infection-control barriers are not in the programme for a ceiling replacement over a clinical room.
trigger: opening a ceiling over a clinical room
early_warning: The ceiling opens into the room.
derisk: Separate the work from the clinical space.

circumstance: A school can only release classrooms in holidays, and the services work does not fit the holiday.
early_warning: The work duration exceeds the holiday.
derisk: Stage the work to the holidays available.

circumstance: An aged-care bedroom upgrade blocks the only path residents use at night.
early_warning: The path is the work zone.
derisk: Keep a path residents can use.

circumstance: Medical gas cannot be isolated to the wing being refurbished without shutting the adjoining wing.
early_warning: There is no zone valve.
derisk: Provide isolation that does not shut the adjoining wing.

circumstance: A university laboratory cannot lose power for the cutover the new board requires.
early_warning: The laboratory must stay powered.
derisk: Plan a temporary supply for the cutover.

circumstance: An existing operating-theatre air handler cannot be taken offline in the hours the contractor planned.
early_warning: The theatre list does not allow the outage.
derisk: Programme the outage to the theatre list.

circumstance: A library's existing floor will not carry the new compactus the brief adds.
early_warning: The load exceeds the floor.
derisk: Check the floor before the compactus is specified.

circumstance: A courthouse secure path is crossed by the only route for the services upgrade.
early_warning: The route enters the secure zone.
derisk: Find a route that does not cross the secure path.

circumstance: A school hall's existing structure was not designed for the retractable seating being added.
early_warning: The seating load is above the floor design.
derisk: Check the floor for the seating.

circumstance: Fire-indicator-panel works in a hospital must stay live, and the panel has no capacity for a temporary overlap.
early_warning: The panel cannot run old and new devices together.
derisk: Plan a changeover that keeps detection live.

circumstance: An existing nurse-call system fails during a partial upgrade because old and new devices are not compatible.
early_warning: The old field devices do not talk to the new head-end.
derisk: Upgrade a compatible set together.

circumstance: A negative-pressure room loses its pressure when the corridor ceiling is opened for other work.
early_warning: The room no longer holds pressure.
derisk: Keep the room's air path intact while adjacent work proceeds.

circumstance: An existing autoclave steam line has no isolation for the wing being altered.
early_warning: The steam main serves both wings from one valve.
derisk: Provide isolation before the wing is altered.

circumstance: A public swimming-pool plant room upgrade cannot drain the pool for the duration the work needs.
early_warning: The pool must stay open.
derisk: Stage the plant so the pool can stay in service.

circumstance: An existing school stair used for construction access is the students' only stair.
early_warning: Students and the works share the stair.
derisk: Separate construction access from the students' stair.

circumstance: A data centre's existing raised floor cannot be lifted while the equipment stays live.
early_warning: The equipment cannot be shut down.
derisk: Plan the work around equipment that stays live.

circumstance: An existing kitchen in an aged-care building cannot meet the food finish once the cool rooms are replaced.
early_warning: The walls behind the rooms are not a cleanable finish.
derisk: Include the finishes the replacement exposes.

circumstance: A justice facility's existing door locks cannot be recoded to the new security zones.
early_warning: The locks are mechanical and not zoned.
derisk: Replace the locks the new zones need.

circumstance: Vibration from construction beside an operating microscope suite exceeds what the suite can accept.
early_warning: The suite records vibration above its limit.
derisk: Use a method inside the limit or move the suite's work.

circumstance: A livable-housing path from the garage is steeper than the provisions allow once the real site fall is set out.
trigger: setting out a house on a sloping site
early_warning: The path grade exceeds the provision.
derisk: Set the path to the site fall before the floor level is fixed.

circumstance: Termite management is bridged where a new porch slab meets the house slab without a barrier.
early_warning: The barrier stops at the joint.
derisk: Continue the barrier across the joint.

circumstance: Condensation appears in a steel-framed wall because the vapour control layer is on the cold side of the insulation.
early_warning: Moisture is on the cold side of the insulation.
derisk: Place the vapour control for the climate.

circumstance: A weatherproofing line and an air barrier are detailed as two products that never meet at the window.
early_warning: The two lines stop short of each other.
derisk: Make one continuous line at the window.

circumstance: A post-tension tendon profile clashes with a cast-in plumbing sleeve the architect added late.
trigger: casting a sleeve into a post-tensioned slab
early_warning: The sleeve is in the tendon.
derisk: Move the sleeve out of the tendon.

circumstance: Concrete strength results for a suspended slab are below the grade the PT stressing procedure assumed.
early_warning: The cylinders are low.
derisk: Do not stress until the strength the procedure needs is confirmed.

circumstance: A facade bracket and the slab-edge reinforcement want the same zone.
early_warning: The bracket anchor is in the bars.
derisk: Coordinate the edge before it is cast.

circumstance: Holding-down bolts for a portal frame are cast outside the tolerance of the base plates.
early_warning: The bolts do not fit the plates.
derisk: Survey the bolts before the frame is fabricated to them, or use a detail that can adjust.

circumstance: A precast panel seat is short because the slab edge was cast in the wrong place.
early_warning: The panel does not bear fully.
derisk: Survey the edge before the panels are made.

circumstance: Stair headroom fails under a beam that was deepened after the stair was drawn.
early_warning: The headroom is to the beam, not the slab.
derisk: Check headroom to the deepest soffit.

circumstance: An accessible path exceeds the grade once the pavement is set out to the real levels.
early_warning: The built grade is too steep.
derisk: Set the levels so the path complies.

circumstance: A fire collar is missing where a stack passes a sole-occupancy floor in a new apartment building.
early_warning: The pipe is open through the slab.
derisk: Collar the stack at each separating floor.

circumstance: A rooftop plant screen required by the permit is outside the planning envelope.
early_warning: The screen exceeds the envelope.
derisk: Fit the screen inside the envelope or amend the permit.

circumstance: Balcony depth measured to the finished facade is short of the planning minimum.
early_warning: The depth to the finished face is short.
derisk: Measure depth to the finished face.

circumstance: A car-park clearance is lost under a beam the traffic drawing ignored.
early_warning: The beam is below the required clearance.
derisk: Measure clearance to the lowest obstruction.

circumstance: A loading-dock headroom is lost under a transfer beam.
trigger: setting a dock under a beam
early_warning: The beam is below the truck.
derisk: Check the truck path to the beam.

circumstance: Sanitary compartments do not fit the circulation once the services are in the wall.
early_warning: The clear room is short.
derisk: Plan the room after the wall build-up.

circumstance: A refuge is undersized for the occupant load the final plan shows.
early_warning: The area is below the load.
derisk: Size the refuge to the load.

circumstance: End-of-trip rooms are short of the numbers the permit states.
early_warning: The fixture count is short.
derisk: Fit the numbers the permit states.

circumstance: A waste room will not fit the bins the council collects.
early_warning: The bins do not fit.
derisk: Size the room to the collection.

circumstance: A column lands in an accessible turning circle.
early_warning: The column is inside the circle.
derisk: Keep the circle clear of structure.

circumstance: A skylight well cannot pass a roof beam.
early_warning: The beam is in the well.
derisk: Move the well or the beam.

circumstance: Ground anchors for a basement would pass under the neighbour without consent.
early_warning: The anchors enter the adjoining land.
derisk: Get consent or choose a system that stays on the site.

circumstance: A pile rig cannot penetrate the rock the boreholes described as soil.
early_warning: The rig refuses on rock.
derisk: Choose a method for the rock that is there.

circumstance: Groundwater is higher than the basement was designed to resist.
early_warning: Water enters above the design level.
derisk: Design the basement for the water found.

circumstance: Acid sulfate soil oxidises in the spoil from a basement.
early_warning: Testing identifies acid sulfate soil.
derisk: Manage the spoil and the concrete for the soil.

circumstance: A site classification is more reactive than the footing design used.
early_warning: The classification is a higher class.
derisk: Design the footings to the classification.

circumstance: Uncontrolled fill is found under a house pad the slab design treated as natural ground.
early_warning: The fill is not engineered.
derisk: Found the slab on ground the design can rely on.

circumstance: A proof roll fails immediately before an industrial slab pour.
early_warning: The subgrade moves under the roller.
derisk: Do not pour on a subgrade that fails.

circumstance: Differential founding from rock to deep soil exceeds the articulation of a house slab.
trigger: founding a slab on variable ground
early_warning: Rock and deep soil are under one slab.
derisk: Articulate the slab for the difference.

circumstance: A soakage system is designed in clay that fails the permeability test.
early_warning: The test fails.
derisk: Design disposal for the soil.

circumstance: Town-main pressure will not serve the top floor without a pump the design omitted.
early_warning: The pressure is low at the top floor.
derisk: Add a pump or reduce the height the main must serve.

circumstance: A fire hydrant main cannot reach the most remote point at the pressure available.
early_warning: The remote hydrant is below the required pressure.
derisk: Size the pumps and pipes to the remote point.

circumstance: A sprinkler obstruction from a bulkhead is not in the hydraulic design.
early_warning: The bulkhead shadows the spray.
derisk: Move the head or the bulkhead.

circumstance: A smoke exhaust has no make-up air path.
early_warning: The exhaust quantity has no inlet.
derisk: Provide make-up air.

circumstance: A curtain wall's stack joint is closed by the slab deflection calculated after the facade was procured.
early_warning: The joint is smaller than the deflection.
derisk: Size the joint to the deflection.

circumstance: Roof falls on a new concrete roof do not reach the outlets.
early_warning: Water ponds short of the outlets.
derisk: Form falls to the outlets and test them.

circumstance: A window opening is outside the tolerance of the manufactured frame.
early_warning: The frame does not fit.
derisk: Hold openings to the frame tolerance.

circumstance: Insulation is compressed by the cladding sub-frame and loses its thickness.
early_warning: The insulation is crushed at the frame.
derisk: Keep the insulation thickness where the frame crosses it.

circumstance: Services puncture the air barrier and the holes are left open.
early_warning: The holes are unsealed.
derisk: Seal every penetration to the barrier.

circumstance: A box gutter has no overflow to outside.
early_warning: The gutter can only overflow into the building.
derisk: Provide an overflow that discharges outside.

circumstance: Weep holes are rendered over.
early_warning: The weeps are closed.
derisk: Keep the weeps open.

circumstance: A balcony door threshold is below the external tiles.
early_warning: The tiles are above the threshold.
derisk: Set the threshold above the tiles.

circumstance: Balustrade posts are fixed through the balcony membrane.
early_warning: The bolts pierce the membrane.
derisk: Fix the posts without breaking the membrane.

circumstance: A wet-area set-down is not cast, so the floor cannot fall to the waste.
early_warning: The slab is flat.
derisk: Cast the set-down.

circumstance: A floor-waste flange does not suit the membrane specified.
early_warning: The flange and the membrane are not a pair.
derisk: Match the flange to the membrane.

circumstance: A fire door rating does not match the wall it is installed in.
early_warning: The tag is a lower rating than the wall.
derisk: Match the door to the wall.

circumstance: Emergency lighting spacing fails once the final rooms are built.
early_warning: The path is dark.
derisk: Space the lights to the final path.

circumstance: A lift shaft is out of plumb beyond the rail adjustment.
early_warning: The plumb exceeds the adjustment.
derisk: Build the shaft to the lift tolerance.

circumstance: A switchroom is too small for the board and its clearance.
early_warning: The clearance does not fit.
derisk: Size the room to the board.

circumstance: Consumer mains are undersized for the maximum demand.
early_warning: The mains are below the demand.
derisk: Size the mains to the demand.

circumstance: Voltage drop fails on the longest subcircuit as built.
early_warning: The route is longer than calculated.
derisk: Calculate the route that will be built.

circumstance: A hydrant booster cannot be seen from the brigade attendance point.
early_warning: The booster is hidden.
derisk: Place it where the appliance can see it.

circumstance: A fire pump start drops voltage on the rest of the board.
early_warning: Other loads drop out.
derisk: Check the board for the pump start.

circumstance: Condensate from a fan coil has no fall to a drain.
early_warning: The tray cannot fall.
derisk: Provide a discharge.

circumstance: Outside air is taken next to a kitchen exhaust.
early_warning: The intake is too close to the exhaust.
derisk: Separate them.

circumstance: A kitchen exhaust has no rated riser.
early_warning: There is no shaft.
derisk: Provide a rated path.

circumstance: Plant noise at the boundary exceeds the limit of the selected unit.
early_warning: The sound data exceeds the limit.
derisk: Select plant that meets the limit.

circumstance: A sewer connection is above the fixture outlets.
early_warning: The fixtures cannot fall to the connection.
derisk: Set the fixtures to the connection that exists or pump.

circumstance: A stack clashes with a beam.
early_warning: The beam is on the stack.
derisk: Move one of them.

circumstance: Tempered water is too far from the outlet.
early_warning: The pipe length exceeds the limit.
derisk: Move the valve closer.

circumstance: A trade-waste arrestor has no access for the collection vehicle.
early_warning: The vehicle cannot reach it.
derisk: Place it where it can be serviced.

circumstance: Rainwater is cross-connected to potable water.
early_warning: The supplies join.
derisk: Separate them.

circumstance: A basement wall kicker has no waterstop and leaks.
early_warning: The joint weeps.
derisk: Install the waterstop.

circumstance: A pile penetrates the membrane with no collar.
early_warning: The membrane is cut at the pile.
derisk: Collar the pile.

circumstance: Scaffold is loaded onto a slab that is still propped.
early_warning: The props are still carrying the slab.
derisk: Do not add scaffold load until the slab can take it.

circumstance: A temporary batter slips into the excavation.
early_warning: The batter moves.
derisk: Support the cut until it is retained or backfilled.

circumstance: Retention piles cannot reach toe level because of rock.
early_warning: The piles stop on rock short of toe.
derisk: Design the toe for the rock.

circumstance: A ground anchor fails its proof test.
early_warning: The anchor does not hold.
derisk: Do not rely on an anchor that fails its test.

circumstance: Concrete cover is low where a membrane must bond.
trigger: preparing a slab for a membrane
early_warning: The cover is low and the surface is weak.
derisk: Provide a surface the membrane can bond to without exposing steel.

circumstance: A movement joint between a new frame and an existing frame is built solid.
trigger: joining new work to an existing building
early_warning: The joint is filled rigid.
derisk: Leave the joint free to move.

circumstance: Solar-array feet land between purlins.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The feet miss the purlins.
derisk: Land the feet on the purlins.

circumstance: Dissimilar metals touch at a flashing and corrode.
early_warning: The metals are in contact.
derisk: Separate them.

circumstance: Safety glass is not used in a pane that requires it.
early_warning: The pane is unmarked.
derisk: Use the grade the location requires.

circumstance: An internal gutter overflow is blocked.
early_warning: The overflow is sealed.
derisk: Keep the overflow open to outside.

circumstance: Photovoltaic feet are not an approved membrane penetration.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The warranty excludes the foot.
derisk: Use a penetration the membrane allows.

circumstance: A hearing loop fails because of the slab reinforcement.
early_warning: The field collapses.
derisk: Test the loop with the reinforcement.

circumstance: A gas interlock is not wired to the exhaust fan.
early_warning: Gas is available with the fan off.
derisk: Interlock the gas to the exhaust.

circumstance: Eyewash water is not tempered and has no drain.
early_warning: The eyewash is cold only and undrained.
derisk: Provide tempered water and a drain.

circumstance: Chemical drainage is the wrong material for the chemical used.
early_warning: The pipe does not resist the chemical.
derisk: Match the material to the chemical.

circumstance: A hazardous-area zone is larger than the equipment rating.
early_warning: The equipment is not rated for the zone.
derisk: Match the equipment to the zone.

circumstance: Discrimination between breakers is not achieved with the devices supplied.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The curves overlap.
derisk: Supply the devices the study used.

circumstance: A compartment wall stops at the ceiling.
early_warning: The wall does not reach the slab.
derisk: Take the wall to the slab.

circumstance: A penetration seal is not the product tested for the gap built.
early_warning: The gap is outside the test.
derisk: Use a system tested for the gap.

circumstance: Cable-tray fill exceeds the tested fill of the wall seal.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The fill is over the test.
derisk: Reseal for the fill installed.

circumstance: Racking is taller than the sprinkler design.
early_warning: The storage exceeds the design.
derisk: Limit the storage or upgrade the sprinklers.

circumstance: A fire-isolated stair contains a cable tray.
early_warning: The tray is inside the stair.
derisk: Remove it from the stair.

circumstance: Intumescent coating thickness does not suit the member size supplied.
early_warning: The section factor differs from the specification.
derisk: Coat to the member supplied.

circumstance: A smoke door does not latch because the floor is out of level.
early_warning: The leaf binds.
derisk: Level the floor or adjust the frame.

circumstance: Hose-reel coverage misses a room.
early_warning: The room is outside the reel radius.
derisk: Add a reel or move the room.

circumstance: A detection zone crosses two compartments.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The zone crosses the wall.
derisk: Match the zone to the compartment.

circumstance: Exit signs are hidden by a bulkhead.
early_warning: The sign cannot be seen.
derisk: Keep the sightline.

circumstance: Sprinkler heads clash with the ceiling grid.
early_warning: The heads miss the tiles and the wall distance.
derisk: Coordinate the grid and the heads.

circumstance: A kitchen hood does not cover the appliances.
early_warning: Appliances sit outside the hood.
derisk: Match the hood to the appliances.

circumstance: A vision panel is larger than the fire door's test.
early_warning: The glass exceeds the test.
derisk: Keep the tested size.

circumstance: A gaseous-suppression room is not airtight.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The fan test shows leakage.
derisk: Tighten the room before the agent quantity is fixed.

circumstance: A warden phone cannot be cabled to the panel.
early_warning: There is no path.
derisk: Provide a path.

circumstance: Paint covers a smoke seal.
early_warning: The seal is painted.
derisk: Mask the seal.

circumstance: A fire shutter leaves a gap on a sloping floor.
project_types: new build; replacement/upgrade of an existing system
early_warning: The floor falls away from the shutter.
derisk: Sill the shutter to the floor.
